stitched_ep01_ep03_betrayal_revenge.text:
[00:11.30 - 00:13.10] MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding): "You should turn around, Juliana."
[00:13.50 - 00:14.30] LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless): "Why?"
[00:15.50 - 00:17.50] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving): "Gerald is waiting for me."
[00:18.00 - 00:19.40] MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving): "Not anymore."
[00:21.80 - 00:23.50] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading): "What do you mean?"
[00:23.80 - 00:25.50] MATRIARCH (Dismissive): "Look for yourself."

[01:06.00 - 01:08.10] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[01:09.90 - 01:12.10] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing): "Take your hands off her."
[01:13.00 - 01:16.80] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching): "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
[01:17.20 - 01:18.90] ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening): "Stand aside, stranger!"
[01:19.30 - 01:20.90] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly): "I said..."
[01:21.80 - 01:23.90] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising): "...let her go."
[01:24.00 - 01:25.50] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[01:24.50 - 01:25.40] SOUND FX: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.

ep036_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[02:26.50 - 02:28.00] ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing): "What wedding?"
[02:28.80 - 02:31.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim): "Rupert... and Catherine's."
[02:30.50 - 02:33.00] SOUND FX: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
[02:33.50 - 02:36.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious): "Two days from now."
[02:36.80 - 02:39.80] ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury): "They are marrying in two days..."
[02:40.50 - 02:43.00] ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty): "...and killing my wife afterward."
[02:43.20 - 02:46.80] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified): "Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!"
[02:48.50 - 02:50.80] ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething): "They already took my name."
[02:51.60 - 02:53.60] ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction): "They stole my home!"
[02:54.20 - 02:56.80] ALEXANDER (Venomous): "And now they have taken Juliana!"
[02:57.00 - 02:59.50] ACTION: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
[02:57.50 - 02:59.20] SOUND FX: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
[03:00.00 - 03:04.00] ACTION: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.
[03:02.00 - 03:03.50] ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling): "Two days."
[03:04.50 - 03:07.80] ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance): "Then they have two days to celebrate."
[03:09.50 - 03:12.20] ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise): "Because before that wedding begins..."
[03:13.00 - 03:16.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale): "...their dead Duke is coming home."
[03:17.00 - 03:20.75] ACTION: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
[03:17.00 - 03:20.75] SOUND FX: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

ep007_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:01.80 - 01:04.80] JULIANA (Cold, Commanding): "You have no authority here. Leave."
[01:05.60 - 01:08.50] GERALD (Furious, Threatening): "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
[01:08.60 - 01:09.50] GERALD (Spiteful, Boastful): "And your husband?"
[01:09.50 - 01:11.20] GERALD (V.O.) (Snarl): "Where is that beggar husband?"
[01:10.00 - 01:15.50] ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
[01:16.20 - 01:17.50] SOUND FX: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
[01:21.50 - 01:24.00] ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
[01:26.50 - 01:28.50] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed): "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
[01:28.60 - 01:30.00] GERALD (Trembling, Trying to Save Face): "What are you staring at?"
[01:30.00 - 01:31.50] ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
[01:30.10 - 01:31.40] GERALD (Nervous, Hurried): "We are leaving."
[01:32.00 - 01:33.80] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Outraged, Flustered): "Leaving? Gerald!"
[01:33.80 - 01:36.50] ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
[01:35.00 - 01:36.00] SOUND FX: Carriage door slamming shut.
[01:40.80 - 01:43.20] JULIANA (Impressed, Softly Amused): "You didn't say a word."
[01:46.00 - 01:47.80] SCARRED BEARDED MAN (Low, Gentle, Confident): "I didn't need to."

ep044_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:17.40 - 00:19.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming): "Do something!"
[00:21.80 - 00:24.40] ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
[00:25.20 - 00:28.00] CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful): "Alexander... I thought you had died."
[00:28.40 - 00:31.00] CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping): "Do you know what this did to me?"
[00:31.20 - 00:32.40] CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading): "I mourned you."
[00:32.40 - 00:34.00] CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling): "I waited for you."
[00:34.20 - 00:38.80] CATHERINE (Heartbroken): "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
[00:38.90 - 00:41.20] CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing): "I never stopped loving you."
[00:41.20 - 00:42.80] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
[00:44.20 - 00:46.40] CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt): "You don't remember?"
[00:46.60 - 00:48.80] CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding): "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
[00:49.20 - 00:51.00] ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable): "You were never my Duchess."
[00:51.10 - 00:52.80] CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading): "But I loved you!"
[00:53.00 - 00:55.50] ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting): "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
[00:56.20 - 00:58.20] CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained): "No!"
[00:59.80 - 01:02.40] CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying): "I loved you before all this!"
[01:02.50 - 01:03.40] ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting): "Did you?"
[01:08.00 - 01:09.60] ACTION: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
[01:10.10 - 01:10.40] CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous): "Her?!"

ep046_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:29.30 - 01:32.40] HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening): "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
[01:32.20 - 01:36.20] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
[01:36.80 - 01:40.40] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening): "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
[01:41.80 - 01:46.50] ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute): "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
[01:47.00 - 01:51.50] HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching): "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
[01:52.00 - 01:58.20] ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding): "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
[01:58.80 - 02:03.60] HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious): "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
[02:04.00 - 02:06.50] ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed): "I'll take that wager over your decree."
[02:07.20 - 02:13.20] ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing): "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
[02:14.00 - 02:16.00] ACTION: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
[02:14.20 - 02:18.50] HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning): "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."
[02:19.00 - 02:22.00] SOUND FX: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
[02:21.20 - 02:23.80] CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious): "Ten days is plenty of time."

ep001_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:30.90 - 01:31.90] MATRIARCH (Stern, Resolute): "Enough!"
[01:32.10 - 01:35.50] MATRIARCH (Disgusted): "You have embarrassed this family long enough."
[01:36.20 - 01:38.20] LADY JULIANA (Incredulous): "Embarrassed you?"
[01:38.80 - 01:41.50] MATRIARCH (Haughty): "Clarissa knows how to carry herself."
[01:41.60 - 01:45.00] MATRIARCH (Proud): "She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting."
[01:45.40 - 01:47.30] LADY JULIANA (Raw, Painful): "And I am what?"
[01:47.50 - 01:50.80] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Viciously Calm): "You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to."
[01:51.10 - 01:53.00] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating): "I am the daughter they choose."
[01:53.30 - 01:55.70] MATRIARCH (O.S.) (Firm): "Clarissa is the jewel of this family."
[01:57.00 - 01:59.00] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Dignified): "So that is what I was worth to you?"
[01:59.80 - 02:02.30] THE FORMER GROOM (Scornful, Hard): "You have nothing to offer me anymore."
[02:04.20 - 02:07.50] THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Dismissive): "I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value..."
[02:08.50 - 02:11.20] THE FORMER GROOM (Reverent toward Clarissa): "...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county."
[02:11.30 - 02:13.80] ACTION: Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.
[02:13.80 - 02:17.00] ACTION: Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.
[02:15.00 - 02:17.50] SOUND FX: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.

ep002_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:06.10 - 01:09.30] OFF-SCREEN VOICE (Dismissive, Condescending): "You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding."
[01:09.40 - 01:12.70] THE FORMER GROOM (Impatient, Commanding): "Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity."
[01:14.40 - 01:16.40] LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant): "Dignity?"
[01:16.50 - 01:19.00] LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing): "You abandoned a woman who trusted you..."
[01:19.20 - 01:22.50] LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing): "...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth."
[01:23.00 - 01:26.50] LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald."
[01:26.80 - 01:33.00] LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding): "You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable."
[01:33.40 - 01:36.60] LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing): "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
[01:38.20 - 01:42.80] ACTION: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
[01:38.50 - 01:42.40] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud): "I may leave this chapel without a husband..."
[01:43.00 - 01:47.40] LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit): "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed."
[01:47.40 - 01:50.00] ACTION: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

ep012_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:44.00 - 00:46.40] CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring): "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[00:46.70 - 00:52.30] CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive): "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[00:52.40 - 00:56.70] CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic): "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[00:56.80 - 00:58.00] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[00:57.30 - 01:00.60] CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[01:00.80 - 01:03.10] GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive): "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[01:03.30 - 01:05.10] CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional): "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[01:05.40 - 01:09.20] CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing): "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
[01:09.60 - 01:11.20] ACTION: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
[01:09.80 - 01:13.80] ALEXANDER (Desperate, Protective, Urgent): "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
[01:14.20 - 01:16.00] ACTION: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
[01:15.30 - 01:18.20] JULIANA (Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial): "I am not letting them take you."
[01:21.50 - 01:23.00] ACTION: Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
[01:22.80 - 01:24.70] JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Tell me where the garden is."
[01:24.70 - 01:27.21] ACTION: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

ep038_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:45.50 - 00:47.50] JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading): "What if I die here?"
[00:47.80 - 00:50.50] JULIANA (Heartbroken): "What if I never see you again?"
[00:48.50 - 00:51.00] ACTION: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
[00:51.50 - 00:53.50] JULIANA (Fervent Prayer): "Keep him safe."
[00:53.80 - 00:55.30] JULIANA (Resigned): "Wherever he is."
[00:55.50 - 00:57.00] JULIANA (Determined): "Let him live."
[00:57.50 - 01:00.50] JULIANA (Steely): "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
[01:00.80 - 01:02.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable): "I will not give them my husband."
[01:02.80 - 01:04.20] JULIANA (Resolute): "I will not betray him."
[01:04.50 - 01:06.50] ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
[01:04.80 - 01:27.00] SOUND FX: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
[01:09.00 - 01:10.30] JULIANA (Startled Whisper): "Bells."
[01:11.00 - 01:13.50] ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
[01:12.80 - 01:14.20] JULIANA (Realizing): "The wedding."
[01:14.50 - 01:15.80] JULIANA (Grim): "It's beginning."
[01:16.00 - 01:18.50] JULIANA (Somber, Steely): "Then I suppose I'm next."
[01:21.00 - 01:24.00] ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
[01:22.50 - 01:24.00] JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender): "Alexander..."
[01:24.50 - 01:27.91] SOUND FX: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

ep040_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:09.80 - 01:14.20] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless, Victorious): "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
[01:14.80 - 01:17.40] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadly, Uncompromising): "And its witch will be dead."
[01:18.50 - 01:21.00] SOUND FX: The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.
[01:32.00 - 01:34.20] LADY HARRINGTON (Awestruck, Whispering): "She looks like a queen."
[01:40.00 - 01:42.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enamored, Flattering): "You look more queen than bride."
[01:45.00 - 01:49.00] CATHERINE (Smug, Coquettish): "And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin."
[01:49.00 - 01:50.08] ACTION: Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.

ep004_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:53.00 - 01:54.80] THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming): "...husband and wife!"
[01:54.00 - 01:55.20] SOUND FX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[01:55.00 - 01:56.80] GERALD (Furious, Shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[01:57.00 - 01:59.00] GERALD (Livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[02:00.50 - 02:02.80] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[02:03.00 - 02:05.50] JULIANA (Firm, Final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[02:06.00 - 02:07.40] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[02:07.50 - 02:11.50] LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[02:12.00 - 02:14.50] LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous): "You are disowned!"
[02:19.50 - 02:20.80] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective): "Come, Lady Juliana."
[02:25.00 - 02:26.50] ACTION: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
[02:27.50 - 02:31.40] ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.
[02:27.00 - 02:29.00] SOUND FX: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

ep028_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:53.30 - 01:55.80] JULIANA (Screaming, Wildly Defiant): "Do not speak about my husband!"
[01:56.40 - 01:59.10] CATHERINE (Laughing, Scornful): "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
[01:59.20 - 02:01.80] CATHERINE (Mocking): "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
[02:02.00 - 02:04.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Harsh, Authoritative): "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
[02:05.00 - 02:05.70] CATHERINE (Smug): "And this?"
[02:05.90 - 02:08.70] CATHERINE (Gleeful): "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
[02:09.10 - 02:11.00] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "That book is my mother's life's work!"
[02:11.40 - 02:14.20] CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening): "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."
[02:14.60 - 02:16.70] CATHERINE (Fateful, Vengeful): "...before he sends you to the gallows."

ep005_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:54.50 - 00:57.50] ACTION: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.
[00:55.50 - 00:56.80] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "Barbara, don't!"
[00:57.00 - 00:58.20] SOUND FX: A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
[00:59.00 - 01:02.50] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Mocking): "Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!"
[01:02.40 - 01:04.60] GERALD (Smug, Cruel): "Perhaps that is where it belongs."
[01:05.50 - 01:08.50] ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
[01:10.50 - 01:14.50] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
[01:17.80 - 01:19.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Gentle): "Here you go."
[01:20.50 - 01:22.00] JULIANA (Choked, Weeping): "They destroyed it."
[01:22.50 - 01:25.40] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Calm, Grounded): "They dirtied it. That is not the same thing."
[01:26.50 - 01:27.80] JULIANA (Broken): "It was my mother's."
[01:27.90 - 01:29.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle, Protective): "Then keep it."
[01:28.50 - 01:31.00] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.
[01:29.40 - 01:31.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Comforting): "Let them keep everything else."
[01:31.50 - 01:32.80] GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant): "Look at you."
[01:33.00 - 01:36.50] GERALD (Scornful, Spiteful): "A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!"
[01:38.00 - 01:40.80] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Lethally Cold): "Choose your next words carefully."
[01:44.20 - 01:45.20] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Reassuring): "Come."
[01:46.00 - 01:50.50] SOUND FX: Rain gently pattering on cobblestones beneath a sweeping, melancholic orchestral swell that slowly fades to black.

ep024_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:37.00 - 00:38.80] NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing): "Not a physician. Not a lady."
[00:39.00 - 00:42.80] NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final): "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."
[00:43.20 - 00:44.80] LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled): "Yes, my lady."
[00:45.50 - 00:48.00] NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending): "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."
[00:48.50 - 00:51.50] ACTION: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
[00:51.50 - 00:53.50] ACTION: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
[00:53.60 - 00:55.20] NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive): "Clean it."
[00:56.20 - 00:57.60] LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning): "All of it, my lady?"
[00:57.80 - 01:03.50] NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous): "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."
[01:03.80 - 01:06.00] ACTION: Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
[01:06.00 - 01:07.50] ACTION: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
[01:06.20 - 01:07.50] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading): "My lady—"
[01:07.50 - 01:09.50] ACTION: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
[01:08.00 - 01:10.50] NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening): "Do you want the same punishment?"
[01:10.60 - 01:12.40] PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring): "No, my lady."
[01:12.50 - 01:14.50] ACTION: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
[01:13.00 - 01:21.00] SOUND FX: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
[01:15.00 - 01:18.00] NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful): "That is where clever little servants belong."
[01:18.60 - 01:21.00] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute): "Let her think I am only a maid."
[01:21.20 - 01:25.00] ACTION: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
[01:21.50 - 01:24.80] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant): "Let her believe I am ignorant."
[01:25.20 - 01:31.50] ACTION: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
[01:25.60 - 01:29.80] LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable): "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

ep011_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:58.00 - 01:00.10] JULIANA (Distressed, Pleading): "Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!"
[01:00.00 - 01:01.80] ACTION: The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
[01:01.80 - 01:03.80] JULIANA (Crying, Desperate): "Please! There is nothing here!"
[01:03.90 - 01:05.70] CONSTABLE (Cold, Indifferent): "Then you have nothing to fear."
[01:06.00 - 01:07.50] JULIANA (Heartbroken, Sobbing): "Those are all I have left!"
[01:07.50 - 01:11.60] GERALD (Cruel, Condescending): "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."
[01:12.10 - 01:15.00] JULIANA (Furious, Accusatory): "You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!"
[01:15.50 - 01:16.80] GERALD (Scoffing, Sinister): "Happy?"
[01:21.30 - 01:24.00] GERALD (Provoking, Smirking): "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"
[01:24.20 - 01:25.00] JULIANA (Whispering, Terrified): "Don't!"
[01:26.00 - 01:27.50] ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Haunted, Resolute): "One blow would end this."
[01:28.00 - 01:30.00] ALEXANDER (V.O.) (Pained, Selfless): "But one blow would destroy her life."
[01:31.00 - 01:32.20] ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
[01:32.10 - 01:33.20] JULIANA (Startled, Shouting): "That is his coat!"
[01:35.80 - 01:37.00] SOUND FX: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
[01:37.20 - 01:39.00] ACTION: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
[01:44.20 - 01:46.60] GERALD (Gloating, Victorious): "There it is. Ha!"

ep019_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:05.10 - 01:10.50] INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed): "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
[01:10.90 - 01:13.20] INFORMANT (O.S.): "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
[01:13.50 - 01:16.40] INFORMANT (Grave): "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
[01:16.20 - 01:18.80] ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
[01:16.50 - 01:18.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury): "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
[01:19.00 - 01:21.00] INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn): "And everyone believes you are dead."
[01:21.50 - 01:23.70] ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating): "Then let them believe it a little longer."
[01:24.00 - 01:25.50] INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense): "And when we have the proof?"
[01:25.90 - 01:28.90] ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute): "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
[01:37.20 - 01:40.00] ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
[01:37.40 - 01:39.40] JULIANA (O.S.): "We have lost everything."
[01:40.40 - 01:42.60] JULIANA (Despairing, Broken): "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."
[01:43.00 - 01:46.00] ACTION: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
[01:44.20 - 01:46.20] ALEXANDER (Soft, Steadfast): "Tomorrow, we begin again."
[01:47.30 - 01:49.20] JULIANA (Faint Smile, Emotional): "You make it sound so simple."
[01:49.80 - 01:52.50] ACTION: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.

ep042_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:23.50 - 00:25.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[00:25.50 - 00:26.50] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged): "Why?!"
[00:26.70 - 00:28.80] ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[00:29.00 - 00:30.30] CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[00:30.50 - 00:33.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[00:34.00 - 00:39.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[00:40.20 - 00:42.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears): "Alexander..."
[00:44.80 - 00:48.00] ACTION: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
[00:48.00 - 00:49.00] ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent): "Mother."
[00:49.00 - 00:54.00] ACTION: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
[00:49.20 - 00:53.80] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving): "Look at you... my beautiful boy."
[00:54.00 - 01:01.80] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud): "I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
[01:02.00 - 01:04.00] ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute): "I have come home, Mother."
[01:04.00 - 01:12.50] ACTION: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
[01:04.20 - 01:12.40] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative): "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"
[01:13.80 - 01:17.50] ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful): "And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

ep022_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:17.50 - 01:21.00] ACTION: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
[01:19.00 - 01:21.00] PRUDENCE (Relieved, Whispering): "That was close."
[01:22.50 - 01:24.50] LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Quiet): "Where is the West Wing?"
[01:24.80 - 01:28.00] PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning): "Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."
[01:31.50 - 01:36.00] ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
[01:34.50 - 01:36.00] LADY JULIANA (Breathless): "This house..."
[01:36.00 - 01:38.50] ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
[01:36.00 - 01:38.50] PRUDENCE (Panicked, Hushed): "Do not stare. Keep walking."
[01:45.50 - 01:48.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
[01:46.50 - 01:48.50] SOUND FX: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
[01:49.00 - 01:54.00] SOUND FX: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
[01:53.80 - 01:56.00] ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
[01:54.00 - 01:55.50] LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Concerned): "Your Grace?"
[01:58.20 - 01:59.80] LADY JULIANA (Soft, Comforting): "Do not speak."
[02:03.00 - 02:05.80] ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
[02:03.50 - 02:05.80] LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring): "This isn't ordinary fever."
[02:05.80 - 02:07.00] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
[02:07.20 - 02:08.80] LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Alarmed): "Who has been treating you?"

ep008_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:25.00 - 00:26.80] JULIANA (Hesitant, Soft): "Your hair and beard..."
[00:30.10 - 00:31.90] JULIANA (Gentle, Tender): "I could trim them for you."
[00:33.20 - 00:34.50] ALEXANDER (Firm, Low): "Not yet."
[00:35.80 - 00:36.90] JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious): "Not yet?"
[00:37.70 - 00:38.90] ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady): "Let them grow."
[00:39.90 - 00:42.00] JULIANA (Playful, Amused): "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[00:43.70 - 00:44.90] ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll): "It has advantages."
[00:45.50 - 00:46.80] JULIANA (Fond, Resigned): "Very well."
[00:48.10 - 00:49.60] JULIANA (Teasing, Determined): "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
[00:50.10 - 00:51.20] ALEXANDER (Low, Amused): "We'll see."
[00:53.30 - 00:57.00] ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm): "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."
[00:58.70 - 01:00.20] JULIANA (Soft, Nostalgic): "My mother wrote the same thing."
[01:00.50 - 01:02.80] JULIANA (Hesitant, Compassionate): "And the scars... were they from the war?"
[01:03.20 - 01:04.20] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Subdued): "Some were."
[01:04.90 - 01:06.30] JULIANA (Tender, Aching): "It must have been terrible."
[01:06.70 - 01:07.60] ALEXANDER (Heavy, Somber): "It was."
[01:09.00 - 01:12.10] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I thought losing wealth meant losing everything."
[01:13.20 - 01:15.30] JULIANA (Quiet, Transformed): "Perhaps I was wrong."
[01:15.30 - 01:18.00] ACTION: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

ep045_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:08.80 - 01:10.50] CATHERINE (Trembling, Stunned): "Wife?!"
[01:11.20 - 01:14.50] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.
[01:11.50 - 01:14.00] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Resounding): "Before the Crown and before God..."
[01:14.60 - 01:20.00] ACTION: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.
[01:14.80 - 01:20.40] ALEXANDER (Proclaiming, Powerful): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"
[01:21.50 - 01:23.00] RUPERT (Gasping, Shellshocked): "Juliana?!"
[01:26.50 - 01:28.20] SOUND FX: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
[01:27.50 - 01:31.00] ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
[01:28.40 - 01:30.80] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern): "No one will bow yet!"
[01:33.20 - 01:41.00] ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
[01:33.20 - 01:41.10] HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe): "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
[01:41.50 - 01:45.50] HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official): "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
[01:46.20 - 01:48.80] HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute): "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
[01:49.00 - 01:53.00] HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning): "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
[01:53.50 - 01:57.20] ACTION: Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
[01:58.00 - 02:01.75] ACTION: Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

ep017_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:06.00 - 01:13.50] ACTION: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.
[01:17.00 - 01:21.00] ACTION: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.
[01:18.50 - 01:20.00] JULIANA (Soft, Playful): "Your heart is racing."
[01:21.20 - 01:22.50] ALEXANDER (Warm, Whispering): "So is yours."
[01:26.50 - 01:30.00] ACTION: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.
[01:28.00 - 01:29.80] JULIANA (Lighthearted, Teasing): "This is becoming impossible."
[01:30.40 - 01:32.50] JULIANA (Smiling): "Soon birds will start nesting in it."
[01:33.50 - 01:35.20] ALEXANDER (Dry, Amused): "They have not complained yet."
[01:35.50 - 01:37.00] ACTION: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.
[01:36.50 - 01:39.20] JULIANA (Charming, Tender): "Then I shall have to save you from the birds."
[01:39.50 - 01:42.50] ACTION: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.
[01:40.30 - 01:41.50] ALEXANDER (Solemn, Gentle): "Not yet."
[01:43.00 - 01:44.20] JULIANA (Sweet, Reassuring): "Then I will wait."
[01:47.00 - 01:54.00] ACTION: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.
[01:48.30 - 01:51.50] JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Resonant): "I know almost nothing about the man I married."
[01:52.20 - 01:56.00] JULIANA (V.O.) (Deeply Moved, Loving): "But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him."
[01:54.00 - 01:58.88] SOUND FX: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.

ep050_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:27.20 - 00:30.20] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous): "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
[00:31.00 - 00:35.00] FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[00:36.50 - 00:39.40] CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[00:40.40 - 00:42.50] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "For as long as it holds."
[00:43.20 - 00:48.00] CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing): "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
[00:49.80 - 00:54.00] FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned): "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
[00:54.80 - 00:56.50] CATHERINE (Murmuring): "In another room no one uses?"
[00:56.80 - 00:59.20] FATHER THOMAS (Whispering): "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
[01:00.30 - 01:04.80] CATHERINE (Low, Carnal): "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
[01:05.80 - 01:10.50] ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
[01:10.80 - 01:13.50] ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
[01:14.00 - 01:16.50] ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
[01:16.80 - 01:18.50] ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
[01:17.20 - 01:18.60] SOUND FX: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

ep023_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:19.00 - 01:21.50] LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious): "Someone is poisoning her."
[01:21.50 - 01:22.50] SOUND FX: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.
[01:22.00 - 01:24.00] PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified): "Poison?"
[01:26.00 - 01:28.00] LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute): "Arsenic."
[01:28.00 - 01:30.50] SOUND FX: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
[01:34.50 - 01:37.00] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging): "Can you save her?"
[01:37.50 - 01:40.00] LADY JULIANA (Focused, Resolute): "I can try."
[01:44.50 - 01:52.00] SOUND FX: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.
[01:47.50 - 01:52.00] LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Focused): "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."
[01:52.20 - 01:54.00] SOUND FX: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!
[01:58.80 - 02:04.00] PRUDENCE (Terrified, Hoarse Whisper): "Juliana... someone is coming."
[02:09.20 - 02:11.20] SOUND FX: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.

ep014_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:33.20 - 00:37.00] ACTION: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.
[00:35.80 - 00:38.50] ALEXANDER (Deep, Sorrowful): "You should never have had to bleed for me."
[00:40.50 - 00:43.50] SOUND FX: Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
[00:44.00 - 00:47.00] ACTION: Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
[00:44.00 - 00:47.50] SOUND FX: Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
[00:47.20 - 00:49.80] ALEXANDER (Hoarse, Stricken): "You could have lost your hands."
[00:51.80 - 00:54.00] JULIANA (Whispered, Emotional): "But I didn't lose you."
[00:58.50 - 01:00.00] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Tender): "I'm sorry."
[01:00.50 - 01:02.50] JULIANA (Gentle, Reassuring): "You didn't hurt me."
[01:06.00 - 01:07.40] JULIANA (Loving, Earnest): "You have taken my place today."
[01:07.50 - 01:09.80] JULIANA (Continuing): "And you are doing it better than me."
[01:11.00 - 01:16.00] ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
[01:16.50 - 01:21.00] ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow): "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again."
[01:21.20 - 01:23.50] ACTION: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
[01:24.00 - 01:27.00] ACTION: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.
[01:24.50 - 01:27.63] SOUND FX: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

ep018_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[02:19.80 - 02:22.50] JULIANA (Crying, Shattered): "Everything we had is gone."
[02:20.50 - 02:24.00] ACTION: Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.
[02:24.00 - 02:35.00] ACTION: Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.
[02:25.80 - 02:28.50] JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Anguished): "Why would anyone do this?"
[02:33.20 - 02:34.80] JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful): "Alexander..."
[02:35.00 - 02:41.00] ACTION: Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.
[02:38.00 - 02:40.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous): "Someone wanted us out."
[02:43.00 - 02:45.50] JULIANA (Despairing, Weeping): "We have nowhere to go."
[02:51.80 - 02:57.20] ALEXANDER (Cold Fury, Resolute): "They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now."
[02:59.50 - 03:04.00] ACTION: Juliana slowly pulls back slightly from his embrace, her tear-filled blue eyes looking up into his hardened features.
[03:04.20 - 03:06.50] JULIANA (Trembling, Apprehensive): "What are you going to do?"

ep015_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:34.80 - 00:36.80] JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): "Leave my garden alone."
[00:37.20 - 00:40.40] THUG WITH CAP (Sneering, Disdainful): "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."
[00:41.00 - 00:44.00] JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."
[00:44.80 - 00:46.40] THUG WITH CAP (Menacing Snarl): "Get out of the way!"
[00:46.50 - 00:47.30] JULIANA (Steely, Fearless): "No."
[00:47.40 - 00:49.50] ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
[00:47.80 - 00:49.00] JULIANA (Gasping Cry): "Ah!"
[00:50.00 - 00:53.50] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
[00:53.50 - 00:55.70] JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing): "My mother's plants..."
[00:57.30 - 00:59.80] BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing): "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"
[01:00.00 - 01:02.00] ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
[01:00.00 - 01:01.00] JULIANA (Screaming): "Stop!"
[01:03.50 - 01:07.50] ACTION: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
[01:10.50 - 01:12.60] JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned): "Alexander..."
[01:16.00 - 01:18.50] ACTION: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
[01:19.00 - 01:22.40] THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant): "What? You want to fight us, veteran?"
[01:24.00 - 01:26.00] SOUND FX: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.

ep037_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:44.00 - 01:47.00] SOUND FX: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
[01:45.50 - 01:47.80] JULIANA (Straining, Defiant Gasps): "I will not!"
[01:49.00 - 01:52.50] JULIANA (Passionate Defiance): "They can take my name. They can take my home."
[01:53.60 - 01:56.20] JULIANA (Indomitable Spirit): "They cannot take who I am!"
[01:57.20 - 01:59.80] NOBLEMAN (Quietly Skeptical): "Do you think she'll actually be executed?"
[02:00.50 - 02:04.20] LADY CLARISSA (Dismissive, Certain): "After what she has been accused of? Of course."
[02:04.80 - 02:06.50] NOBLEMAN (Musing): "She was always stubborn."
[02:07.50 - 02:12.00] LADY CLARISSA (Bitter, Cold): "That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."
[02:12.50 - 02:16.00] ACTION: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
[02:14.00 - 02:21.00] LADY CLARISSA (Venomous Monologue): "Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it."
[02:22.50 - 02:26.50] LADY CLARISSA (Chilling Proclamation): "Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."
[02:25.50 - 02:28.00] ACTION: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.
[02:28.00 - 02:36.47] SOUND FX: A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

ep032_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:43.80 - 01:47.20] JULIANA (Continuing): "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
[01:47.20 - 01:48.80] CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged): "And what is wrong with that?!"
[01:49.50 - 01:52.80] JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating): "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
[01:52.80 - 01:56.00] JULIANA (Unrelenting): "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
[01:56.90 - 01:59.50] JULIANA (Piercing): "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
[01:59.60 - 02:01.80] CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming): "Silence! Silence!"
[02:01.80 - 02:02.80] CATHERINE (Shrieking): "Why?!"
[02:03.00 - 02:05.20] JULIANA (Forceful): "Because I am right!"
[02:05.40 - 02:08.80] JULIANA (Scathing, Direct): "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
[02:09.00 - 02:11.60] JULIANA (Continuing): "You want everyone to fear you."
[02:12.00 - 02:14.00] JULIANA (Mocking, Direct): "But look at you."
[02:15.00 - 02:18.60] JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare): "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
[02:18.60 - 02:20.20] CATHERINE (Choking with Rage): "You insolent—!"
[02:20.40 - 02:22.30] JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant): "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
[02:22.40 - 02:26.50] JULIANA (Final, Condemning): "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
[02:26.60 - 02:28.10] CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting): "You think you can lecture me?!"
[02:28.00 - 02:30.80] ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
[02:28.10 - 02:31.20] CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal): "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"
[02:31.20 - 02:34.38] ACTION: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

ep025_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:57.50 - 02:01.00] ACTION: Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
[01:57.50 - 02:00.20] JULIANA (Pleading, Defiant): "She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."
[02:01.00 - 02:05.00] ACTION: Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
[02:05.80 - 02:07.50] JULIANA (Gentle, Perplexed): "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
[02:08.20 - 02:13.80] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Reproachful): "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."
[02:15.00 - 02:17.00] JULIANA (Vulnerable): "I knew you would worry."
[02:17.40 - 02:22.40] ALEXANDER (Furious, Tormented): "Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."
[02:23.20 - 02:24.60] JULIANA (Defiant, Soothing): "But they didn't."
[02:25.20 - 02:26.40] ALEXANDER (Grim, Fearful): "This time."
[02:27.00 - 02:28.80] JULIANA (Sincere, Steadfast): "I am being careful."
[02:29.00 - 02:31.20] JULIANA (Resolute): "I cannot abandon her."
[02:31.20 - 02:34.00] ACTION: Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.
[02:33.80 - 02:36.20] ALEXANDER (Resigned, Steely): "Then tell me everything."
[02:37.40 - 02:39.20] ALEXANDER (Low, Uncompromising): "Everything you saw."
[02:42.50 - 02:48.00] ACTION: Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.

ep034_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[02:19.60 - 02:22.00] LORD (Derisive): "Even now, she refuses to repent."
[02:22.40 - 02:27.00] JUDGE (Grave, Stern): "Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices."
[02:29.80 - 02:30.80] LADY JULIANA (Unyielding): "No."
[02:31.80 - 02:33.80] JUDGE (Ominous, Warning): "Think carefully."
[02:35.20 - 02:36.40] LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): "I have."
[02:37.00 - 02:41.80] JUDGE (Severe, Imposing): "You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?"
[02:42.10 - 02:43.50] LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless): "Then let it be."
[02:44.00 - 02:46.80] ACTION: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
[02:47.00 - 02:53.60] LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant): "Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."
[02:56.50 - 02:58.20] ACTION: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
[02:56.60 - 02:57.60] SOUND FX: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]
[02:57.80 - 02:59.40] JUDGE (Thunderous): "Enough!"
[02:59.50 - 03:04.50] ACTION: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
[03:01.00 - 03:04.20] JUDGE (Booming, Solemn): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."
[03:05.00 - 03:10.00] ACTION: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

ep039_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:48.20 - 00:49.20] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute): "Tell the Duke."
[00:50.00 - 00:52.80] ACTION: Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
[00:56.50 - 00:59.80] ACTION: Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
[00:57.20 - 01:00.80] SOUND FX: Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
[01:02.00 - 01:06.60] ACTION: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.
[01:02.00 - 01:02.80] ALEXANDER (Deep, Steely Resolve): "Enough hiding."
[01:03.00 - 01:05.50] ALEXANDER (Dark, Unforgiving): "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."
[01:05.60 - 01:06.90] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Commanding): "Today, he comes home."
[01:08.50 - 01:11.80] ACTION: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
[01:15.80 - 01:17.20] LOYALIST (Reverent, Submissive): "Your Grace."
[01:20.50 - 01:22.20] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Command): "Secure the chapel."
[01:23.80 - 01:25.20] LOYALIST (Resolute): "Yes, Your Grace."
[01:25.50 - 01:27.20] ALEXANDER (Powerful, Roaring Defiance): "No more hiding."
[01:27.50 - 01:30.20] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Unyielding): "I am taking back my house."
[01:30.20 - 01:35.00] ACTION: Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.
[01:35.00 - 01:38.00] ALEXANDER (Passionate, Unstoppable Vow): "And I am bringing my wife home."
[01:37.80 - 01:38.41] ACTION: Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

ep047_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:24.00 - 01:26.50] ALEXANDER (Indignant, Protective): "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
[01:26.70 - 01:27.80] JULIANA (Calm, Composed): "She did."
[01:28.20 - 01:31.00] JULIANA (Dignified, Principled): "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
[01:31.00 - 01:35.00] ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
[01:31.50 - 01:35.00] JULIANA (Steely, Direct): "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
[01:36.00 - 01:38.80] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned): "You want me? As a guest?"
[01:39.20 - 01:41.00] JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm): "As a scullery maid."
[01:41.50 - 01:44.50] CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous): "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[01:45.20 - 01:48.50] JULIANA (Measured, Commanding): "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
[01:48.80 - 01:51.50] JULIANA (Stern, Demanding): "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
[01:51.80 - 01:54.50] JULIANA (Unforgiving): "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
[01:54.80 - 01:58.50] JULIANA (Stern, Final): "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
[01:59.20 - 02:01.60] CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated): "You humiliate me."
[02:02.20 - 02:07.20] JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign): "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
[02:08.50 - 02:11.20] CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated): "I accept, Your Grace."

ep003_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:36.50 - 01:38.50] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical): "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
[01:38.80 - 01:40.80] THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Deep, Resonant): "I can..."
[01:40.80 - 01:43.80] THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Stern, Accusing): "...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church."
[01:44.20 - 01:47.40] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle): "You shouldn't have to beg anybody..."
[01:47.40 - 01:49.00] THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Affirming, Sincere): "...to remember your worth."
[01:50.90 - 01:52.50] LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Bewildered): "Why are you doing this?"
[01:52.80 - 01:54.10] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Simple, Certain): "Because I want to."
[01:59.80 - 02:02.10] THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest): "You came here to become a wife."
[02:02.50 - 02:04.20] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute): "They took that from you."
[02:05.30 - 02:07.30] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere): "I am offering it back."
[02:07.70 - 02:09.90] LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant): "You don't even know me."
[02:10.40 - 02:12.00] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady): "I know enough."
[02:13.20 - 02:15.50] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
[02:14.80 - 02:16.20] SOUND FX: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
[02:17.50 - 02:20.30] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted): "Lady Juliana... accept my hand."
[02:20.50 - 02:25.75] ACTION: Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.

ep030_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:42.20 - 01:43.90] CATHERINE (Scheming): "Her botanical ledger..."
[01:44.80 - 01:46.00] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming): "Exactly."
[01:47.30 - 01:48.80] CATHERINE (Inquiring): "And the Dowager?"
[01:49.50 - 01:56.50] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive): "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
[02:00.00 - 02:01.50] RUPERT (Hesitant): "And Juliana?"
[02:02.40 - 02:04.90] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute): "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
[02:05.50 - 02:13.00] CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant): "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."
[02:14.10 - 02:16.20] RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful): "I will write the arrest warrant myself."
[02:17.50 - 02:23.50] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive): "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."
[02:24.50 - 02:31.21] SOUND FX: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.
[02:28.50 - 02:31.21] ACTION: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.

ep010_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:45.30 - 00:47.10] JULIANA (Soft, Sorrowful): "You have suffered terribly."
[00:47.80 - 00:49.00] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Somber): "It is over."
[00:49.70 - 00:51.30] JULIANA (Gentle): "Your scars disagree."
[00:52.00 - 00:53.30] JULIANA (Tender): "Does it hurt?"
[00:54.00 - 00:55.20] ALEXANDER (Gruff): "Not much."
[00:55.60 - 00:57.60] JULIANA (Playful, Whispering): "You are a terrible liar."
[01:03.90 - 01:06.10] JULIANA (Soft, Breathless): "Why do you look at me like that?"
[01:06.50 - 01:08.40] ALEXANDER (Intense, Sincere): "Because you are looking at me."
[01:09.60 - 01:10.90] JULIANA (Flustered, Whispering): "Hold still."
[01:12.10 - 01:14.20] ALEXANDER (Low, Husky): "I am holding still."
[01:16.80 - 01:19.00] ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable): "Perhaps it is your hand."
[01:22.60 - 01:25.90] ALEXANDER (Deep, Emotional): "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."

ep013_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:11.40 - 01:13.80] ALEXANDER (Desperate, Choked): "Please... enough!"
[01:14.50 - 01:18.00] ACTION: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
[01:18.50 - 01:20.50] JULIANA (Screaming in Pain): "Ah!"
[01:20.50 - 01:23.00] ACTION: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
[01:20.80 - 01:22.20] ALEXANDER (Furious, Booming): "Stop!"
[01:23.00 - 01:26.00] ACTION: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
[01:23.80 - 01:25.80] JULIANA (Agonized Scream): "Ahhh!"
[01:26.50 - 01:28.80] ALEXANDER (Roaring in Torment): "Juliana!"
[01:29.20 - 01:34.00] ACTION: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
[01:34.80 - 01:36.40] ALEXANDER (Desperate Shout): "Juliana!"
[01:38.20 - 01:42.50] JULIANA (Panting, Praying): "Please, ring... you have to be here."
[01:43.00 - 01:46.50] ACTION: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
[01:49.00 - 01:52.00] ACTION: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.

ep033_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[02:06.80 - 02:11.50] MAID (Crying Out, Desperate): "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[02:12.00 - 02:14.00] LORD (Cold, Final): "That will be your testimony."
[02:14.50 - 02:17.00] MAID (Gasping, Shocked): "My testimony?!"
[02:18.00 - 02:20.00] LORD (Unyielding): "Before the magistrate."
[02:20.50 - 02:24.00] MAID (Wailing, Tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"
[02:25.00 - 02:26.50] LORD (Chillingly Detached): "You do not need to."
[02:26.80 - 02:29.00] LORD (Chillingly Detached): "I have already written the story for you."
[02:29.50 - 02:32.00] MAID (Sobbing): "She saved my brother..."
[02:32.50 - 02:36.00] LORD (Inexorable): "And now... you will save your brother."
[02:36.20 - 02:39.50] ACTION: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
[02:39.00 - 02:41.50] MAID (Weeping, Broken): "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."
[02:41.80 - 02:44.50] LORD (Cold, Merciless): "Save your tears for the trial."
[02:44.50 - 02:54.04] ACTION: The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.

ep026_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:13.80 - 01:19.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching): "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
[01:20.00 - 01:25.80] JULIANA (Painful, Proud): "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
[01:27.00 - 01:30.50] ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[01:30.20 - 01:32.00] SOUND FX: A sharp, stunned gasp.
[01:30.80 - 01:35.00] ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
[01:36.00 - 01:39.80] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken): "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
[01:40.50 - 01:45.00] JULIANA (Confused, Alarmed): "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
[01:46.00 - 01:49.00] ACTION: The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
[01:48.80 - 01:50.00] SOUND FX: A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
[01:49.20 - 01:50.60] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Stern, Desperate): "Do not move!"
[01:51.00 - 01:55.50] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Intense, Demanding): "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"

ep029_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:12.10 - 01:14.30] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Amused): "Your scarred soldier?"
[01:14.70 - 01:18.10] CATHERINE (Derisive, Biting): "What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"
[01:18.70 - 01:20.60] GUARD (Gruff, Dismissive): "Move along, girl."
[01:24.00 - 01:26.50] ACTION: The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.
[01:25.70 - 01:26.50] JULIANA (Crying Out, Broken): "Please!"
[01:26.50 - 01:28.00] SOUND FX: The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
[01:29.50 - 01:33.70] ACTION: Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
[01:34.20 - 01:35.50] JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken): "Mother..."
[01:37.30 - 01:39.50] JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting): "I have done nothing!"
[01:39.70 - 01:42.30] JULIANA (Screaming, Hysterical): "I saved her! I healed her!"
[01:42.50 - 01:45.20] SOUND FX: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.
[01:42.60 - 01:45.30] JULIANA (Shouting in Anguish): "I saved the Duchess!"
[01:46.50 - 01:48.80] JULIANA (V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded): "They took my mother's ledger..."
[01:49.00 - 01:52.60] JULIANA (V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable): "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
[01:52.80 - 01:54.80] SOUND FX: A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.

ep009_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:10.50 - 01:13.00] ACTION: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
[01:11.20 - 01:14.80] PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[01:14.50 - 01:15.50] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[01:15.10 - 01:17.50] ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[01:17.60 - 01:19.40] JULIANA (Defiant, Principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[01:19.60 - 01:21.60] ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
[01:22.00 - 01:23.80] JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable): "Then we will face it together."
[01:24.00 - 01:26.50] ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
[01:26.60 - 01:27.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up): "What is it?"
[01:28.00 - 01:30.30] THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential): "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
[01:30.60 - 01:31.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious): "What rumor?"
[01:32.10 - 01:35.10] THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy): "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
[01:35.30 - 01:37.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant): "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
[01:37.50 - 01:41.20] THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn): "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
[01:41.40 - 01:41.90] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding): "Where?"
[01:42.30 - 01:43.60] THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious): "No one seems certain."
[01:44.20 - 01:45.90] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic): "Then let it remain a rumor."
[01:49.80 - 01:51.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken): "Impossible."

ep020_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:10.60 - 01:12.30] SEAMUS (Desperate, Grieving): "You are a viscount's daughter!"
[01:12.40 - 01:14.20] SEAMUS (Pleading): "Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"
[01:14.30 - 01:16.20] SEAMUS (Frustrated): "Let the village tend to itself for once!"
[01:16.30 - 01:19.80] JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching): "The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left."
[01:19.90 - 01:21.00] JULIANA (Unyielding): "I keep the basket."
[01:22.00 - 01:24.40] SEAMUS (Saddened, Heartbroken): "They have reduced you to a peasant."
[01:24.80 - 01:26.50] JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable): "They have reduced me to myself."
[01:26.60 - 01:28.00] JULIANA (Steely): "And I am not finished."
[01:28.20 - 01:30.00] ACTION: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
[01:28.40 - 01:29.40] SOUND FX: Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
[01:29.90 - 01:32.40] CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous): "Let the peasants rot in their barns."
[01:32.60 - 01:34.50] CATHERINE (Mocking, Spiteful): "Let them pray to their weeds."
[01:34.90 - 01:37.30] RUPERT (Intimate, Reassuring): "You have no rival here, Catherine."
[01:37.40 - 01:39.10] RUPERT (Fawning): "No one to stand in your way."
[01:39.30 - 01:41.40] CATHERINE (Triumphant, Greedy): "Once the old Duchess is gone..."
[01:41.50 - 01:43.70] CATHERINE (Possessive): "...Ashbury will finally belong to us."
[01:43.80 - 01:49.00] ACTION: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
[01:46.80 - 01:49.20] CATHERINE (Cold, Ruthless): "This house will only bow to me."

ep043_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:11.40 - 01:12.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Denying): "I didn't!"
[01:12.80 - 01:15.20] ALEXANDER (Resonant, Accusatory): "And when you believed I was dead..."
[01:16.10 - 01:17.60] ALEXANDER (Venomous): "You took my title."
[01:18.00 - 01:19.40] SOUND FX: Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
[01:21.50 - 01:25.80] CROWN OFFICIAL (Grave, Official): "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
[01:26.00 - 01:28.50] CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing): "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
[01:28.60 - 01:33.00] CROWN OFFICIAL (Loud, Authoritative): "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."
[01:33.40 - 01:36.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Desperate): "I was told he was dead!"
[01:36.80 - 01:39.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Penetrating): "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."
[01:40.00 - 01:42.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Betraying): "Sterling handled the report!"
[01:44.80 - 01:46.20] CATHERINE (Shocked, Murmuring): "My Lord?"
[01:47.00 - 01:49.00] SOUND FX: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
[01:50.40 - 01:52.50] POLICE CONSTABLE (Firm, Sardonic): "Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?"

ep021_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:10.50 - 01:13.50] ACTION: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
[01:12.00 - 01:15.50] PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved): "Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"
[01:15.50 - 01:19.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
[01:16.00 - 01:19.60] LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring): "Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."
[01:19.80 - 01:23.00] PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion): "You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."
[01:23.00 - 01:27.50] PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted): "I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."
[01:27.50 - 01:30.80] ACTION: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
[01:27.70 - 01:30.50] LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere): "Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."
[01:31.00 - 01:34.50] PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful): "At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."
[01:34.60 - 01:36.40] PRUDENCE (Ominous): "But their gold cannot buy them health."
[01:36.50 - 01:38.20] ACTION: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
[01:36.50 - 01:39.20] LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious): "What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"
[01:39.20 - 01:41.20] PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.): "She is dying, Lady Juliana."
[01:41.20 - 01:43.40] PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim): "A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."
[01:43.50 - 01:48.40] PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling): "Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."
[01:48.50 - 01:54.00] ACTION: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

ep031_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:58.40 - 02:02.00] JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative): "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
[02:02.00 - 02:04.00] ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
[02:04.20 - 02:10.50] JULIANA (Accusatory, Commanding): "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
[02:11.00 - 02:12.80] CATHERINE (Enraged Scream): "Enough!"
[02:13.20 - 02:14.50] SOUND FX: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
[02:14.50 - 02:18.00] CATHERINE (Hateful, Malicious): "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
[02:18.00 - 02:20.50] ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
[02:18.40 - 02:20.40] JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping): "[gasping] Give it back!"
[02:20.70 - 02:23.80] CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic): "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
[02:24.00 - 02:25.50] JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized): "No!"
[02:25.60 - 02:31.20] CATHERINE (Vicious, Final): "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
[02:31.50 - 02:35.20] ACTION: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

ep041_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:54.80 - 00:57.50] ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
[00:58.00 - 01:00.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed): "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
[01:01.00 - 01:03.50] CATHERINE (O.S.) (Murmured, Cold): "Still arrogant. Still standing."
[01:04.50 - 01:05.40] CATHERINE (Dismissive): "Come."
[01:10.50 - 01:14.80] CATHERINE (Intimate, Ambitious): "Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."
[01:15.80 - 01:17.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Quietly Triumphant): "Nothing."
[01:18.00 - 01:19.30] PRIEST (Solemn, Polite): "Shall we?"
[01:21.00 - 01:25.50] SOUND FX: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
[01:21.80 - 01:24.00] ACTION: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
[01:29.00 - 01:33.50] ACTION: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.

ep006_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:14.30 - 01:16.80] ACTION: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[01:16.80 - 01:17.80] ACTION: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[01:17.80 - 01:21.00] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[01:21.00 - 01:23.80] ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[01:23.80 - 01:30.00] SOUND FX: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[01:27.50 - 01:29.80] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
[01:29.00 - 01:29.80] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved): "There."
[01:32.10 - 01:33.60] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest): "It is not much."
[01:34.20 - 01:36.20] JULIANA (Soft, Comforted): "It is enough for tonight."
[01:38.40 - 01:40.40] JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I lost my home today."
[01:40.60 - 01:41.80] JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable): "My family."
[01:42.00 - 01:44.80] JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable): "Everything I thought my life would be."
[01:45.00 - 01:46.00] JULIANA (V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised): "And yet..."
[01:46.20 - 01:49.00] JULIANA (V.O.) (Tender, Safe): "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."
[01:51.50 - 01:55.00] SOUND FX: Warm hearth crackles blending with gentle string music fading out.

ep049_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:44.20 - 01:52.80] FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave): "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
[01:53.20 - 01:57.80] CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring): "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
[01:58.20 - 02:04.50] FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark): "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
[02:05.00 - 02:08.50] CATHERINE (Tempting): "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
[02:09.20 - 02:14.20] CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising): "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
[02:15.00 - 02:19.50] ACTION: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.
[02:15.20 - 02:19.50] FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned): "The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."
[02:20.00 - 02:22.50] FATHER THOMAS (Softly): "Then we understand each other."
[02:20.50 - 02:22.80] ACTION: Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.
[02:23.00 - 02:24.00] CATHERINE (Intimate): "We always have."

ep016_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:44.20 - 00:45.30] THUG WITH CAP (Choking, Defiant): "No one!"
[00:46.30 - 00:47.40] ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous): "Wrong answer."
[00:48.00 - 00:50.00] ACTION: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.
[00:48.80 - 00:49.60] ALEXANDER (Roaring): "Who?!"
[00:49.80 - 00:52.20] THUG WITH CAP (Screaming, Panicked): "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"
[00:53.20 - 00:54.40] JULIANA (Shaken, Heartbroken): "Gerald..."
[00:55.50 - 00:58.50] ACTION: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.
[00:56.00 - 00:58.20] THUG WITH CAP (Shouting, Retreating): "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"
[01:00.00 - 01:03.00] ACTION: Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
[01:04.20 - 01:06.20] JULIANA (Soft, Astounded): "You knew exactly what to do."
[01:07.80 - 01:10.20] JULIANA (Wondering, Intrigued): "You fought like you've done this a hundred times."
[01:11.00 - 01:14.00] ALEXANDER (Somber, Heavy-Hearted): "A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget."
[01:14.80 - 01:15.80] JULIANA (Tender, Concerned): "Are you hurt?"
[01:16.00 - 01:17.50] ACTION: Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.
[01:17.80 - 01:18.80] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Steady): "No."
[01:18.80 - 01:23.19] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana gaze deeply into each other's eyes, an unspoken bond forming between them as the ruined garden lies silent beneath the moon.
[01:20.00 - 01:23.19] SOUND FX: Slow, resonant emotional cello melody swelling to a dramatic cliffhanger hold.

ep048_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[00:43.30 - 00:46.80] AGNES (Anxious, Whispering): "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
[00:47.00 - 00:51.30] CATHERINE (Confident, Devious): "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
[00:52.00 - 00:55.00] CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming): "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
[00:55.20 - 00:58.20] CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding): "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
[00:58.50 - 01:00.60] AGNES (Apprehensive): "If someone sees him come to you..."
[01:01.80 - 01:04.00] CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening): "Then no one sees him."
[01:04.30 - 01:06.90] CATHERINE (Authoritative): "That is precisely your job tonight."
[01:07.50 - 01:09.00] SOUND FX: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
[01:07.80 - 01:10.50] CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding): "Send for the priest. Tonight."
[01:10.80 - 01:13.40] CATHERINE (Firm, Final): "And make sure no one sees him arrive."

ep035_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[02:02.00 - 02:05.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned): "Then why did they never tell us?"
[02:06.00 - 02:09.50] ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate): "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
[02:09.50 - 02:10.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless): "Who?"
[02:10.50 - 02:14.00] ACTION: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
[02:11.00 - 02:14.00] ALEXANDER (Brooding): "I spent three years trying to find out."
[02:14.00 - 02:16.80] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
[02:14.00 - 02:17.00] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute): "The ambush was not an accident."
[02:17.00 - 02:24.00] ACTION: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
[02:17.00 - 02:20.50] ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged): "Someone ordered my men to die."
[02:21.00 - 02:24.00] ALEXANDER (Darkly Intimating): "Someone wanted me erased."
[02:24.00 - 02:25.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Terrified): "Who?"
[02:25.50 - 02:30.00] ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling): "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."
[02:30.80 - 02:37.50] SOUND FX: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

ep027_finale_cliffhanger.text:
[01:55.10 - 01:56.50] JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute): "Poison."
[01:58.70 - 01:59.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous): "Poison."
[02:00.40 - 02:02.60] JULIANA (Urgent): "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
[02:03.10 - 02:04.50] LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror): "You hear that?!"
[02:04.80 - 02:08.40] LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing): "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
[02:08.70 - 02:10.80] JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged): "That is not what I said!"
[02:11.20 - 02:12.60] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy): "Enough."
[02:14.80 - 02:18.50] ACTION: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
[02:16.20 - 02:19.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating): "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
[02:19.60 - 02:23.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive): "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
[02:24.00 - 02:24.90] BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern): "Take her."
[02:25.00 - 02:28.00] ACTION: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

ep002_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.50] THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous): "I cannot marry you, Juliana."
[00:02.80 - 00:04.60] ACTION: Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
[00:04.70 - 00:06.50] THE FORMER GROOM (Cruel, Derisive): "You are far too plain..."
[00:06.80 - 00:09.50] THE FORMER GROOM (Off-screen) (Dismissive): "...far too silent..."
[00:09.60 - 00:12.00] THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Conceited): "...and completely beneath the future I deserve."
[00:12.40 - 00:15.50] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Pleading): "Gerald... Look at me."
[00:18.20 - 00:20.60] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Betrayed): "You gave me your word before both our families."
[00:20.90 - 00:23.70] THE FORMER GROOM (Indifferent, Unapologetic): "Promises change when a better choice appears."
[00:24.00 - 00:27.40] LADY JULIANA (Shattered, Disbelieving): "A better choice? Is that what she is?"
[00:27.80 - 00:30.50] THE FORMER GROOM (Resolute, Harsh): "She is what I should have chosen from the beginning."
[00:30.90 - 00:32.40] LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Vulnerable, Begging): "Father..."
[00:34.30 - 00:37.10] LADY JULIANA (Choked with Tears): "Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?"
[00:37.50 - 00:42.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Stern, Cold): "Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana."
