[00:42.50 - 00:44.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Severely, Harsh): "Do not disgrace us further."

ep049_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.00 - 00:04.50] SOUND FX: Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.
[00:01.80 - 00:05.20] ACTION: Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.
[00:05.40 - 00:06.80] CATHERINE (Quietly Chiding): "You took your time."
[00:09.00 - 00:15.20] FATHER THOMAS (Low, Measured): "Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables."
[00:15.80 - 00:18.80] CATHERINE (Pleased, Cold): "Good. That's what I pay her for."
[00:20.00 - 00:22.00] ACTION: Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.
[00:22.20 - 00:27.20] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing."
[00:27.80 - 00:33.00] CATHERINE (Unfazed): "You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."
[00:33.50 - 00:41.50] FATHER THOMAS (Dry, Cynical): "A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."
[00:42.00 - 00:46.50] CATHERINE (Assertive, Warning): "It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."

ep011_opening_hook.text:
[00:02.00 - 00:04.00] ACTION: Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.
[00:05.50 - 00:07.00] ACTION: Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.
[00:08.30 - 00:10.70] JULIANA (Startled, Indignant): "Gerald? What are you doing here?"
[00:11.10 - 00:13.20] GERALD (Arrogant, Smooth): "I came for something that belongs to me."
[00:14.40 - 00:16.70] JULIANA (Furious, Defiant): "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
[00:16.80 - 00:18.70] GERALD (Aggressive, Snarl): "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
[00:19.00 - 00:20.00] JULIANA (Incredulous, Gasping): "What? When?"
[00:20.90 - 00:22.30] GERALD (Cold, Certain): "The last time I came here."
[00:23.00 - 00:24.80] JULIANA (Contemptuous, Outraged): "You never even entered the cottage!"
[00:25.20 - 00:27.00] GERALD (Smug, Threatening): "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
[00:27.30 - 00:29.00] JULIANA (Adamant, Protective): "Alexander would never steal from you."
[00:29.30 - 00:32.80] GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful): "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
[00:33.00 - 00:34.90] ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing): "Choose your next words carefully."
[00:35.10 - 00:37.10] GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic): "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
[00:37.40 - 00:39.20] CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern): "I have received a complaint of theft."
[00:39.70 - 00:41.10] JULIANA (Fierce): "A complaint is not proof."
[00:41.40 - 00:43.30] CONSTABLE (Cold, Procedural): "Then a search will settle the matter."
[00:43.50 - 00:46.30] JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting): "You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!"

ep004_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.50 - 00:03.20] ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
[00:03.40 - 00:04.90] GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant): "Look at him."
[00:05.00 - 00:07.50] GERALD (Scornful): "A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."
[00:07.80 - 00:09.50] ACTION: Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.
[00:09.00 - 00:10.50] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Condescending): "How fitting."
[00:10.60 - 00:14.20] CLARISSA (Taunting): "You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are."
[00:15.50 - 00:17.50] ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
[00:20.00 - 00:21.80] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling): "You don't even know me."
[00:23.50 - 00:25.80] JULIANA (Conflicted, Pained): "You heard what they think I am."
[00:25.90 - 00:27.70] JULIANA (Searching): "Why would you offer me your name?"
[00:28.00 - 00:30.20] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Certain): "Because I know what I see."
[00:32.10 - 00:33.70] JULIANA (Quiet, Hesitant): "And what do you see?"
[00:34.00 - 00:36.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Sincere): "A woman who was betrayed."
[00:36.50 - 00:38.80] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Resolute): "Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."
[00:42.00 - 00:44.80] JULIANA (Soft, Bitter): "You don't know what my family has done to me."

ep012_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.50 - 00:04.50] CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern): "Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft."
[00:04.80 - 00:06.00] ACTION: Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.
[00:05.70 - 00:08.80] JULIANA (Furious, Defiant): "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
[00:10.00 - 00:11.70] CONSTABLE (Blunt, Unyielding): "I found it there myself."
[00:12.30 - 00:13.90] JULIANA (Passionate, Accusatory): "Then someone put it there!"
[00:14.30 - 00:20.60] GERALD (Smug, Condescending): "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
[00:21.60 - 00:23.60] ALEXANDER (Low, Steady, Dangerous): "I have never touched your property."
[00:23.70 - 00:26.80] GERALD (Mocking, Malicious): "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
[00:26.80 - 00:28.00] ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
[00:26.80 - 00:27.90] JULIANA (Enraged, Shouting): "You planted it!"
[00:28.10 - 00:30.00] CLARISSA (Purring, Taunting): "Oh, dear sister..."
[00:30.00 - 00:32.40] CLARISSA (O.S.) (Continuing taunt): "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
[00:32.40 - 00:35.20] JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
[00:35.40 - 00:40.00] CLARISSA (Smooth, Derisive): "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
[00:40.10 - 00:41.50] CLARISSA (Scheming): "Perhaps I can give you one."
[00:42.20 - 00:43.50] JULIANA (Guarded, Cold): "What do you want?"

ep027_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.30 - 00:03.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless): "This ring..."
[00:03.40 - 00:05.80] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding): "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
[00:06.40 - 00:09.30] JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere): "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
[00:09.70 - 00:12.80] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense): "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
[00:13.40 - 00:16.40] JULIANA (Earnest, Defending): "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
[00:17.20 - 00:21.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory): "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
[00:21.80 - 00:25.80] JULIANA (Confused, Gentle): "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
[00:26.60 - 00:31.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping): "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
[00:32.10 - 00:34.80] JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless): "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
[00:35.20 - 00:37.60] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging): "My lost son wore that ring!"
[00:37.80 - 00:40.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading): "Did your husband serve beside him?"
[00:41.00 - 00:44.20] JULIANA (Soft, Reverent): "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."

ep041_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.80 - 00:04.50] ACTION: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.
[00:01.80 - 00:02.80] CATHERINE (Imperious, Commanding): "Wait."
[00:04.90 - 00:08.20] CATHERINE (Haughty, Loud): "Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."
[00:08.50 - 00:12.70] CATHERINE (Cruel, Resonant): "...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."
[00:13.20 - 00:14.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Subdued, Inquiring): "Catherine..."
[00:14.00 - 00:15.30] CATHERINE (Callous, Projecting): "Bring her in."
[00:15.50 - 00:17.50] SOUND FX: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
[00:17.50 - 00:20.00] ACTION: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
[00:26.80 - 00:28.40] CATHERINE (Smug, Taunting): "There she is."
[00:30.50 - 00:31.60] NOBLEWOMAN (Gleeful, Whispering): "Look at her."
[00:31.70 - 00:33.80] NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Chuckling): "She actually came back to the chapel."
[00:34.80 - 00:36.80] NOBLEWOMAN (Scornful, Smug): "Not as a bride this time."
[00:41.00 - 00:44.20] CATHERINE (O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."

ep001_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.00 - 00:04.80] ACTION: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.
[00:07.20 - 00:09.80] ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.
[00:11.30 - 00:13.10] MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding): "You should turn around, Juliana."
[00:13.50 - 00:14.30] LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless): "Why?"
[00:15.50 - 00:17.50] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving): "Gerald is waiting for me."
[00:18.00 - 00:19.40] MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving): "Not anymore."
[00:21.80 - 00:23.50] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading): "What do you mean?"
[00:23.80 - 00:25.50] MATRIARCH (Dismissive): "Look for yourself."
[00:25.60 - 00:29.80] ACTION: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
[00:33.80 - 00:35.00] LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering): "Gerald?"
[00:35.40 - 00:37.70] LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken): "Why are you holding her hand?"
[00:39.10 - 00:41.20] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug): "Because he is marrying me."
[00:41.70 - 00:43.10] LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated): "No..."

ep020_opening_hook.text:
[00:02.90 - 00:04.40] CATHERINE (Smug, Prim): "Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?"
[00:04.60 - 00:07.80] CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily): "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"
[00:08.20 - 00:10.80] RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly): "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."
[00:10.90 - 00:12.70] RUPERT (Boastful, Confident): "The estate is practically ours."
[00:12.80 - 00:15.10] RUPERT (Smug): "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
[00:15.40 - 00:18.70] CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty): "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
[00:18.80 - 00:20.10] CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious): "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
[00:20.10 - 00:21.20] RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm): "And so you shall."
[00:21.30 - 00:24.20] RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial): "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."
[00:24.30 - 00:25.40] RUPERT (Decisive): "...the title is mine."
[00:25.50 - 00:28.20] CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring): "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
[00:28.30 - 00:30.20] CATHERINE (Disdainful): "Her shadow still hangs over this house."
[00:30.20 - 00:32.80] RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister): "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
[00:32.90 - 00:34.40] RUPERT (Gloating): "They call it a wasting of the lungs."
[00:34.20 - 00:36.80] CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel): "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
[00:36.90 - 00:39.10] CATHERINE (Scheming): "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
[00:39.40 - 00:42.40] RUPERT (Cold, Callous): "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
[00:42.60 - 00:44.90] CATHERINE (Vindictive): "Good. The village is already whispering about her."

ep014_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.50 - 00:05.50] ACTION: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
[00:01.00 - 00:05.50] SOUND FX: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
[00:07.70 - 00:09.00] JULIANA (Exhausted, Resolute): "I found it."
[00:10.50 - 00:12.70] JULIANA (Firm, Commanding): "Now release my husband."
[00:12.50 - 00:13.50] ACTION: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
[00:14.20 - 00:15.40] SOUND FX: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
[00:14.50 - 00:15.60] ACTION: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
[00:16.80 - 00:18.00] ALEXANDER (Gasping, Urgent): "Juliana."
[00:18.80 - 00:23.00] ACTION: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
[00:23.10 - 00:25.00] ALEXANDER (Trembling, Heartbroken): "What have they done to you?"
[00:26.50 - 00:28.50] JULIANA (Softly, Stifling Pain): "Nothing they didn't promise."
[00:29.80 - 00:32.00] JULIANA (Faint, Pleading): "Take me home."
[00:33.20 - 00:37.00] ACTION: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.
[00:35.80 - 00:38.50] ALEXANDER (Deep, Sorrowful): "You should never have had to bleed for me."

ep013_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:36.20 - 00:39.50] ACTION: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
[00:37.00 - 00:38.20] CLARISSA (O.S.) (Mocking, Vindictive): "Careful, sister."
[00:39.90 - 00:41.50] CLARISSA (Cruel, Sarcastic): "That garden has swallowed better women than you."
[00:41.80 - 00:45.50] GERALD (Condescending, Arrogant): "Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth."
[00:45.80 - 00:47.00] ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
[00:47.20 - 00:48.80] ALEXANDER (Screaming, Panicked): "Juliana, stop!"
[00:47.80 - 00:49.20] SOUND FX: Rattling of heavy iron chains.
[00:50.00 - 00:53.00] ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
[00:51.50 - 00:52.60] ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping): "Please..."
[00:54.00 - 00:56.50] ACTION: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
[00:54.50 - 00:55.80] JULIANA (Gasping in Pain): "No..."
[00:57.20 - 00:58.60] CLARISSA (O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive): "Look at her hands."
[00:58.80 - 01:01.80] CLARISSA (Mocking, Spiteful): "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."
[01:02.00 - 01:04.00] ACTION: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
[01:02.20 - 01:07.00] GERALD (Taunting, Cruel): "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."

ep027_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:32.10 - 00:34.80] JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless): "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
[00:35.20 - 00:37.60] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging): "My lost son wore that ring!"
[00:37.80 - 00:40.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading): "Did your husband serve beside him?"
[00:41.00 - 00:44.20] JULIANA (Soft, Reverent): "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
[00:44.50 - 00:46.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate): "What is your husband's name?"
[00:46.40 - 00:48.30] SOUND FX: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
[00:48.80 - 00:51.50] ACTION: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
[00:52.20 - 00:55.60] LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory): "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"
[00:56.80 - 00:58.40] JULIANA (Calm, Defiant): "She needed help."
[01:00.00 - 01:01.80] LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious): "What are you hiding?"

ep031_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:39.20 - 00:43.00] JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken): "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
[00:43.20 - 00:48.50] CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter): "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
[00:48.90 - 00:50.80] CATHERINE (Gloating): "Do you remember?"
[00:49.00 - 00:52.00] ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
[00:51.00 - 00:54.80] CATHERINE (Viciously Delighted): "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
[00:55.20 - 00:57.50] SOUND FX: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
[00:55.50 - 00:58.80] CATHERINE (Quietly Venomous): "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
[00:59.20 - 01:01.30] JULIANA (Proud, Measured): "Gerald chose money."
[01:01.50 - 01:03.50] JULIANA (Resolute): "Clarissa chose a coward."
[01:03.80 - 01:05.30] JULIANA (Unyielding): "I chose myself."

ep040_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:44.10 - 00:45.20] LORD HARRINGTON (Inquiring, Subdued): "Of the wedding?"
[00:45.30 - 00:48.30] LADY HARRINGTON (Chilling, Sarcastic): "And everything that comes after it."
[00:50.80 - 00:53.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Nervous, Determined): "Everything must go perfectly."
[00:53.20 - 00:55.80] ACTION: Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
[01:05.00 - 01:06.80] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Scheming): "All entrances are covered?"
[01:06.90 - 01:08.20] ROYAL GUARD (Obedient, Firm): "Every one, my Lord."
[01:08.30 - 01:09.30] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculating): "Good."

ep006_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.40] ACTION: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
[00:02.30 - 00:06.50] SOUND FX: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
[00:04.50 - 00:07.10] ACTION: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
[00:07.20 - 00:09.85] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn, Gentle): "I know this is not the life you came from."
[00:10.10 - 00:11.20] JULIANA (Quiet, Melancholic): "No."
[00:11.30 - 00:13.00] ACTION: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.
[00:13.40 - 00:14.60] JULIANA (Resigned, Soft): "It isn't."
[00:15.20 - 00:18.20] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Guilt-ridden): "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."
[00:18.50 - 00:20.90] JULIANA (Faintly Ironic, Resilient): "I suppose the day was already ruined."
[00:24.50 - 00:26.10] ACTION: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
[00:26.50 - 00:27.70] JULIANA (Surprised, Hesitant): "That is it?"
[00:28.10 - 00:29.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low): "Yes."
[00:29.20 - 00:30.50] SOUND FX: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
[00:30.15 - 00:33.15] JULIANA (Determined, Defiant): "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
[00:33.70 - 00:36.70] ACTION: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
[00:33.80 - 00:36.50] SOUND FX: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
[00:36.70 - 00:40.00] SOUND FX: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
[00:40.70 - 00:41.90] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Humble, Apologetic): "I am sorry."
[00:43.60 - 00:45.00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere): "You came from comfort."

ep008_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.20] ACTION: Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.
[00:00.20 - 00:03.20] JULIANA (Gentle, Somber): "Some of the pages are ruined. Careful."
[00:03.40 - 00:04.50] SOUND FX: Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
[00:05.10 - 00:07.80] JULIANA (Reflective, Reverent): "Mother spent years writing this."
[00:08.50 - 00:10.50] ACTION: Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
[00:10.50 - 00:11.80] JULIANA (Curious, Recognizing): "Yarrow."
[00:12.00 - 00:14.60] ALEXANDER (Calm, Knowledgeable): "Good for wounds. Fever, too."
[00:15.10 - 00:16.10] JULIANA (Inquiring, Soft): "How do you know that?"
[00:16.30 - 00:18.90] ALEXANDER (Somber, Matter-of-Fact): "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
[00:19.40 - 00:21.80] JULIANA (Observant, Lightly Teasing): "You know more about healing than you let on."
[00:22.80 - 00:24.20] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Gritty): "Enough to survive."
[00:25.00 - 00:26.80] JULIANA (Hesitant, Soft): "Your hair and beard..."
[00:30.10 - 00:31.90] JULIANA (Gentle, Tender): "I could trim them for you."
[00:33.20 - 00:34.50] ALEXANDER (Firm, Low): "Not yet."
[00:35.80 - 00:36.90] JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious): "Not yet?"
[00:37.70 - 00:38.90] ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady): "Let them grow."
[00:39.90 - 00:42.00] JULIANA (Playful, Amused): "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[00:43.70 - 00:44.90] ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll): "It has advantages."

ep007_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:04.80] ACTION: Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.
[00:05.00 - 00:11.50] SOUND FX: Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
[00:19.50 - 00:21.00] ACTION: Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
[00:21.00 - 00:24.00] ACTION: Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.
[00:22.00 - 00:24.50] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Mocking, Condescending): "This is where you live now?"
[00:25.00 - 00:29.80] GERALD (Arrogant, Scornful): "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."
[00:30.00 - 00:32.60] JULIANA (Sharp, Unintimidated): "You came all this way just to insult my home?"
[00:33.20 - 00:37.80] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Gloating, Mocking): "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."
[00:38.20 - 00:39.80] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Cruel): "You look like a servant."
[00:41.20 - 00:44.80] JULIANA (Proud, Resolute): "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."

ep017_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.00] ACTION: Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.
[00:03.00 - 00:07.00] ACTION: Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.
[00:09.30 - 00:11.30] JULIANA (Soft, Emotional): "Some of them survived."
[00:11.50 - 00:14.00] SOUND FX: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
[00:11.50 - 00:14.00] ACTION: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
[00:14.30 - 00:15.30] JULIANA (Grateful, Sincere): "Thank you."
[00:16.80 - 00:17.80] ALEXANDER (Gruff, Low): "For what?"
[00:18.20 - 00:20.50] JULIANA (Trembling, Heartfelt): "For standing between me and those men."
[00:21.50 - 00:23.00] ALEXANDER (Unwavering, Firm): "I would do it again."
[00:24.00 - 00:25.70] JULIANA (Whispering, Awed): "Even if there were ten of them?"
[00:26.00 - 00:27.70] ALEXANDER (Deep, Resolute): "As long as I draw breath..."
[00:28.00 - 00:31.50] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
[00:28.80 - 00:31.00] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Vowing): "...no one will hurt you again."
[00:32.80 - 00:34.20] JULIANA (Choked Up, Pained): "You cannot promise that."
[00:34.80 - 00:35.80] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Absolute): "I just did."
[00:36.50 - 00:39.00] ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
[00:40.00 - 00:44.50] ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
[00:42.80 - 00:44.70] JULIANA (Tender, Reproachful): "You were bleeding last night."

ep023_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.80 - 00:06.00] PRUDENCE (Anxious, Whispering): "Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come."
[00:07.50 - 00:11.80] ACTION: Juliana cradles the Duchess's frail hands in hers, inspecting her fingers with furrowed brows.
[00:13.50 - 00:16.00] LADY JULIANA (Hushed, Grave): "How long has she been like this?"
[00:16.80 - 00:19.50] PRUDENCE (Tearful, Trembling): "Weeks."
[00:24.00 - 00:27.50] LADY JULIANA (Solemn): "Her mouth is terribly dry."
[00:29.00 - 00:31.50] LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Grim): "Her pulse is weak."
[00:32.00 - 00:36.00] PRUDENCE (Despairing, Weeping): "The physician said her heart is failing."
[00:36.00 - 00:38.50] SOUND FX: Duchess's raspy, labored inhalation.
[00:40.80 - 00:43.00] LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): "No."
[00:43.80 - 00:46.50] LADY JULIANA (Certain, Focused): "This is not simply old age."

ep030_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:04.50] SOUND FX: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.
[00:03.00 - 00:05.50] ACTION: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.
[00:06.80 - 00:07.90] SOUND FX: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.
[00:08.80 - 00:13.30] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory): "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
[00:13.60 - 00:16.80] RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious): "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
[00:17.30 - 00:25.80] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving): "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
[00:26.50 - 00:29.20] RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid): "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
[00:32.10 - 00:33.30] RUPERT (Fearful): "If she speaks..."
[00:33.40 - 00:35.20] ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
[00:33.60 - 00:39.80] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous): "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
[00:41.80 - 00:43.50] RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive): "What are you suggesting?"
[00:44.80 - 00:47.30] ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous): "We stop hiding the prisoner."

ep005_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.50] ACTION: Juliana grips the heirloom ledger tightly against her waist, her posture resolute despite the tension.
[00:04.20 - 00:05.80] LORD ASHCROFT (Stern, Commanding): "Miss Ashcroft."
[00:05.50 - 00:06.60] ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
[00:06.80 - 00:10.40] LORD ASHCROFT (Cold, Condemnatory): "You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name."
[00:11.70 - 00:15.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Steadfast): "The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now."
[00:16.00 - 00:18.00] LORD ASHCROFT (Harsh, Final): "Then leave as his wife."
[00:18.50 - 00:20.80] LORD ASHCROFT (Harsh, Final): "You leave as no daughter of mine."
[00:21.00 - 00:23.00] LORD ASHCROFT (O.S. / Continues): "Your dowry is revoked."
[00:23.10 - 00:25.10] LORD ASHCROFT (O.S. / Continues): "Your inheritance is revoked."
[00:25.40 - 00:28.90] LORD ASHCROFT (O.S. / Continues): "From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family."
[00:29.50 - 00:33.40] JULIANA (Shaking, Tearful): "You truly mean it? You are my father!"
[00:33.80 - 00:36.80] LORD ASHCROFT (O.S.): "And you have chosen to become a stranger."
[00:37.60 - 00:41.50] JULIANA (Quietly Resolute): "No, Father. You chose that long before today."
[00:42.50 - 00:44.20] LADY ASHCROFT (Sharply Dismissive): "Enough sentiment."

ep022_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:04.00] ACTION: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.
[00:06.50 - 00:08.50] ACTION: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.
[00:07.00 - 00:11.10] PRUDENCE (Urgent, Whispering): "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."
[00:11.20 - 00:14.20] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet): "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
[00:14.20 - 00:19.00] PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning): "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
[00:19.10 - 00:21.00] LADY JULIANA (Determined): "The Duchess is dying."
[00:22.00 - 00:25.50] LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): "I saved Toby. I can save her."
[00:26.00 - 00:28.10] PRUDENCE (Fretful): "And if they discover who you are?"
[00:28.20 - 00:31.00] LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless): "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
[00:33.80 - 00:36.00] PRUDENCE (Solemn): "Then forget you were ever a lady."
[00:37.00 - 00:39.50] LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute): "Today, I am only a maid."
[00:39.80 - 00:42.50] ACTION: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
[00:41.50 - 00:42.80] SOUND FX: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.
[00:43.00 - 00:44.20] HOUSEKEEPER (Sharp, Stern, O.S.): "Prudence."

ep035_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:05.20] ACTION: Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.
[00:05.50 - 00:08.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Determined, Breathless): "I will not die in that house."
[00:09.50 - 00:12.80] ACTION: She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.
[00:11.20 - 00:13.00] SOUND FX: Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.
[00:13.00 - 00:15.50] ACTION: The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.
[00:15.50 - 00:19.50] ACTION: Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.
[00:16.00 - 00:19.50] SOUND FX: Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.
[00:21.00 - 00:23.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Weary): "This must be the place."
[00:24.80 - 00:27.00] SOUND FX: Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.
[00:28.50 - 00:30.80] ACTION: Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
[00:37.00 - 00:40.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing, Stunned): "Alexander!"
[00:42.50 - 00:44.20] ALEXANDER (Breathless, In Disbelief): "Mother?"

ep015_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.50] ACTION: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.
[00:03.60 - 00:04.90] ACTION: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.
[00:03.80 - 00:04.90] SOUND FX: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.
[00:05.10 - 00:07.40] ACTION: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
[00:07.60 - 00:11.80] ACTION: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.
[00:08.50 - 00:11.70] JULIANA (Desperate, Alarmed): "Stop! What are you doing?!"
[00:13.00 - 00:15.70] THUG WITH CAP (Mocking, Smug): "We're clearing this rubbish."
[00:16.40 - 00:18.70] JULIANA (Furious, Pleading): "Those are medicinal plants!"
[00:20.00 - 00:22.30] BALD THUG (Callous): "They look like weeds to me."
[00:20.50 - 00:22.50] ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
[00:22.80 - 00:26.50] ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
[00:23.20 - 00:26.30] JULIANA (Choked with Tears, Desperate): "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"
[00:27.50 - 00:31.20] TALL THUG (Contemptuous, Derisive): "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"
[00:34.80 - 00:36.80] JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): "Leave my garden alone."
[00:37.20 - 00:40.40] THUG WITH CAP (Sneering, Disdainful): "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."
[00:41.00 - 00:44.00] JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified): "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."

ep016_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.10] ACTION: Alexander stands tall and unyielding, blocking the path to Juliana, while the Thug with Cap steps forward clutching an iron pipe.
[00:02.10 - 00:04.20] THUG WITH CAP (Menacing, Goading): "Move aside, soldier."
[00:06.40 - 00:08.80] THUG WITH CAP (Furious, Shouting): "I said, move!"
[00:11.20 - 00:12.70] JULIANA (Frightened, Whispering): "Alexander..."
[00:13.10 - 00:14.30] ALEXANDER (Calm, Protective): "Stay behind me."
[00:14.40 - 00:15.50] THUG WITH CAP (Roaring): "Aaargh!"
[00:14.40 - 00:16.80] ACTION: The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
[00:15.80 - 00:16.50] SOUND FX: Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
[00:19.20 - 00:21.80] ACTION: Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
[00:19.80 - 00:21.20] SOUND FX: Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
[00:23.00 - 00:23.80] BALD THUG (Yelling): "Aaargh!"
[00:24.20 - 00:25.50] SOUND FX: Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
[00:25.80 - 00:27.10] THIRD THUG (Desperate, Shouting): "Stay back!"
[00:26.50 - 00:28.50] ACTION: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
[00:27.00 - 00:28.20] SOUND FX: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
[00:32.00 - 00:33.80] JULIANA (Breathless, Overwhelmed): "Alexander..."
[00:36.20 - 00:37.80] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Concerned): "Are you hurt?"
[00:38.20 - 00:40.00] JULIANA (Fragile, Pain-filled): "Only my hands."
[00:41.20 - 00:44.00] ACTION: Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.
[00:42.50 - 00:44.00] ALEXANDER (Demanding, Threatening): "Who sent you?"

ep003_opening_hook.text:
[00:02.10 - 00:04.20] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking, Spiteful): "Look at you..."
[00:03.60 - 00:08.20] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Scornful): "...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here."
[00:08.80 - 00:10.80] LADY JULIANA (Hurt, Bitter): "You stole my wedding."
[00:11.20 - 00:13.40] LADY JULIANA (Defiant): "Don't pretend you've earned anything."
[00:13.80 - 00:16.30] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Smug, Malicious): "I didn't steal what was never truly yours."
[00:16.60 - 00:18.40] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Resolute): "This was my wedding."
[00:18.70 - 00:20.40] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Taunting, Cruel): "It was supposed to be."
[00:20.60 - 00:22.50] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Vindictive): "Now it is mine."
[00:23.10 - 00:25.50] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Harsh, Authoritative): "Enough, Juliana."
[00:25.90 - 00:28.00] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Disgusted): "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."
[00:30.40 - 00:33.20] LADY JULIANA (Pained, Betrayed): "I was humiliated by your family."
[00:33.30 - 00:35.60] LADY JULIANA (Accusing): "And my father said nothing."
[00:36.50 - 00:38.40] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Brutal, Dismissive): "Your father has made his choice."
[00:38.50 - 00:40.40] LADY JULIANA (Choked, Vulnerable): "And what happens to me?"
[00:40.50 - 00:41.90] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Heartless): "You leave."
[00:42.10 - 00:43.30] LADY JULIANA (Disbelieving): "Leave where?"
[00:43.40 - 00:46.00] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cruel, Scornful): "Wherever a discarded daughter belongs."

ep036_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.80] ACTION: Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.
[00:00.80 - 00:03.70] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Distraught): "Then why did they never find you?"
[00:04.80 - 00:08.20] ALEXANDER (Cold, Bitter): "Because they made certain no one would look."
[00:09.50 - 00:11.20] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling): "Who?"
[00:13.50 - 00:17.00] ALEXANDER (Grave, Sinister): "Sterling... and Rupert."
[00:17.60 - 00:19.80] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Stricken): "Rupert?"
[00:21.00 - 00:23.50] ALEXANDER (Stern, Resolute): "They knew where I was."
[00:23.70 - 00:28.80] ALEXANDER (Fierce): "My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."
[00:29.20 - 00:31.70] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Horrified): "They gave you to the enemy?"
[00:32.00 - 00:34.50] ALEXANDER (Deadpan, Resolute): "They gave them my location."
[00:36.20 - 00:38.70] ALEXANDER (Spitting with Contempt): "They wanted the investigation buried."
[00:39.10 - 00:41.40] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shattered): "And when you disappeared...?"
[00:41.60 - 00:43.70] ALEXANDER (Cold): "They declared me dead."

ep047_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.80 - 00:08.20] CATHERINE (Calculated, Defiant): "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."
[00:08.80 - 00:14.50] CONSPIRATOR (Low, Warning): "Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."
[00:15.00 - 00:18.20] CATHERINE (Commanding, Scheming): "Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."
[00:18.50 - 00:21.20] CATHERINE (Ruthless, Focused): "Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."
[00:23.40 - 00:26.80] JULIANA (Anxious, Trembling): "What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"
[00:27.00 - 00:30.30] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Fearful): "What if they strip your title? Because of me?"
[00:30.50 - 00:35.00] ACTION: Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.
[00:31.00 - 00:35.20] JULIANA (Despairing): "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
[00:35.80 - 00:37.80] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Resolute): "Look at me, Juliana."
[00:38.20 - 00:42.50] ALEXANDER (Fierce, Loving): "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
[00:43.00 - 00:45.50] ALEXANDER (Deep, Unwavering): "You are my wife."

ep025_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.60 - 00:04.20] ACTION: Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.
[00:05.10 - 00:06.40] ALEXANDER (Grave, Alert): "Juliana."
[00:07.80 - 00:09.60] ALEXANDER (Concerned, Suspicious): "Why are you walking like that?"
[00:10.20 - 00:12.80] JULIANA (Deflective, Breathless): "I am tired. That is all."
[00:13.20 - 00:16.00] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
[00:14.90 - 00:16.10] ALEXANDER (Sharp, Alarmed): "You're hurt."
[00:16.80 - 00:18.50] JULIANA (Strained, Minimizing): "It is nothing."
[00:18.80 - 00:22.50] ACTION: Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
[00:24.00 - 00:25.50] ALEXANDER (Seething, Dangerous): "Who did this?"
[00:27.50 - 00:29.30] JULIANA (Subdued, Weary): "It does not matter."
[00:32.80 - 00:34.50] ACTION: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
[00:32.80 - 00:33.80] ALEXANDER (Demanding, Stern): "Who?"
[00:36.00 - 00:37.80] JULIANA (Quiet, Apprehensive): "Lady Catherine."
[00:39.20 - 00:41.00] ALEXANDER (Low, Interrogating): "Where did you meet her?"
[00:41.20 - 00:44.20] JULIANA (Hedged): "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."

ep029_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.50] SOUND FX: Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.
[00:02.90 - 00:05.10] ACTION: Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.
[00:07.40 - 00:11.70] JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping): "Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"
[00:13.20 - 00:17.30] JULIANA (Pleading, Agonized): "It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"
[00:21.00 - 00:24.00] CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending): "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
[00:24.80 - 00:26.70] CATHERINE (Cruel, Smug): "You still call this a legacy?"
[00:27.10 - 00:28.70] JULIANA (Defiant, Furious): "It is medicine!"
[00:30.40 - 00:31.80] CATHERINE (Smooth, Patronizing): "Of course."
[00:31.90 - 00:37.30] CATHERINE (O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating): "Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."
[00:37.70 - 00:40.00] CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening): "The magistrate will call it witchcraft."
[00:40.10 - 00:41.80] JULIANA (Furious, Shouted): "You know that is a lie!"
[00:42.00 - 00:44.20] CATHERINE (Calm, Sinister): "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
[00:44.40 - 00:46.50] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "You cannot just destroy it!"

ep009_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.80] ACTION: Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.
[00:02.00 - 00:03.50] SOUND FX: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
[00:02.80 - 00:04.00] ACTION: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
[00:03.60 - 00:05.00] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective): "Stay back. I'll open it."
[00:04.80 - 00:06.60] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
[00:06.30 - 00:11.10] PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping): "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
[00:11.40 - 00:13.30] JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate): "Bring him here. Quickly."
[00:12.00 - 00:14.20] ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
[00:15.50 - 00:19.80] JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused): "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
[00:20.50 - 00:23.90] PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious): "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
[00:27.20 - 00:28.80] ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
[00:29.00 - 00:30.80] JULIANA (Muttering, Intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[00:31.80 - 00:33.80] JULIANA (Determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[00:34.90 - 00:35.80] ALEXANDER (Grave): "You're certain?"
[00:36.30 - 00:37.40] JULIANA (Resolute): "I have to be."
[00:38.00 - 00:39.80] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[00:38.20 - 00:39.80] JULIANA (Urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[00:39.90 - 00:40.80] ALEXANDER (Prompt): "I'm on it."
[00:40.80 - 00:42.50] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[00:41.00 - 00:42.50] PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing): "Please save him."
[00:42.20 - 00:43.50] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.

ep034_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.20 - 00:07.80] JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
[00:09.00 - 00:11.20] SOUND FX: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
[00:09.10 - 00:12.60] JUDGE (O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe): "Do you deny possessing this book?"
[00:13.80 - 00:14.80] LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching): "No."
[00:15.60 - 00:19.20] JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory): "Do you deny using its remedies?"
[00:20.80 - 00:21.80] LADY JULIANA (Firm): "No."
[00:27.50 - 00:31.20] JUDGE (Hard, Pressing): "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
[00:33.20 - 00:35.10] LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified): "I admit to healing the sick."
[00:35.30 - 00:37.40] ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
[00:35.40 - 00:36.60] JUDGE (Furious, Shouting): "Silence!"
[00:35.80 - 00:37.00] SOUND FX: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
[00:37.50 - 00:41.20] JUDGE (Commanding): "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
[00:41.00 - 00:43.00] ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
[00:43.20 - 00:44.60] PRUDENCE (Trembling, Tearful): "Yes, Your Honor."

ep026_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:05.50] ACTION: Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
[00:06.50 - 00:09.00] SOUND FX: Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
[00:11.00 - 00:14.00] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
[00:14.20 - 00:20.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Raspy): "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
[00:20.60 - 00:25.40] JULIANA (Urgent, Reassuring): "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
[00:25.80 - 00:28.40] ACTION: The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
[00:30.80 - 00:35.50] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Faint, Discerning): "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
[00:36.00 - 00:39.80] JULIANA (Humble, Sincere): "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
[00:40.30 - 00:43.00] JULIANA (Gentle, Calming): "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."

ep038_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.50] ACTION: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
[00:03.20 - 00:06.00] SOUND FX: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
[00:05.00 - 00:07.50] ACTION: Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
[00:08.50 - 00:11.00] ACTION: The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
[00:11.00 - 00:15.50] ACTION: The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
[00:16.00 - 00:17.30] JULIANA (Breathless, Bewildered): "Why?"
[00:17.50 - 00:20.30] GUARD (Subdued, Sincere): "Because no one should die hungry."
[00:20.50 - 00:22.00] GUARD (Urgent, Whispered): "Eat it before they see."
[00:21.80 - 00:23.20] ACTION: The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
[00:23.50 - 00:27.50] ACTION: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.
[00:26.00 - 00:27.50] JULIANA (Choked Up, Tearful): "Thank you."
[00:27.80 - 00:31.00] ACTION: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
[00:31.00 - 00:34.50] ACTION: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.
[00:34.50 - 00:36.50] JULIANA (Sorrowful, Whispering): "Alexander..."
[00:36.80 - 00:39.00] JULIANA (Yearning): "...are you safe?"
[00:40.00 - 00:43.00] JULIANA (Desperate, Trembling): "Do you even know what happened to me?"

ep048_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.00] ACTION: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
[00:02.40 - 00:07.50] CATHERINE (Vindictive, Cold): "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
[00:07.80 - 00:12.30] ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
[00:08.00 - 00:12.30] CATHERINE (Scheming): "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
[00:12.60 - 00:14.90] CATHERINE (Intense, Measured): "Ten days for the council to sit."
[00:15.00 - 00:18.50] ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
[00:15.10 - 00:17.20] CATHERINE (Calculating): "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
[00:17.40 - 00:19.70] CATHERINE (Dark, Threatening): "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
[00:20.10 - 00:23.70] CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute): "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
[00:23.90 - 00:26.50] CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm): "And doors can be closed from the other side."
[00:26.80 - 00:29.50] ACTION: Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.
[00:29.20 - 00:30.80] AGNES (Hushed, Submissive): "You sent for me, my lady?"
[00:30.90 - 00:32.00] CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp): "Lock it."
[00:32.30 - 00:33.80] SOUND FX: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
[00:34.00 - 00:36.50] ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
[00:34.20 - 00:37.10] CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing): "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
[00:37.30 - 00:39.00] CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating): "Good. Let them remember it."
[00:39.20 - 00:43.00] CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory): "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."

ep021_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.
[00:03.50 - 00:04.80] SOUND FX: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
[00:04.20 - 00:08.00] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked): "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
[00:08.20 - 00:10.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
[00:08.50 - 00:11.00] LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent): "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
[00:11.20 - 00:15.00] PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless): "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
[00:15.00 - 00:18.20] LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained): "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
[00:18.20 - 00:21.70] PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful): "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
[00:21.80 - 00:25.30] PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful): "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
[00:25.10 - 00:27.40] LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected): "We have no clinic now."
[00:27.50 - 00:30.80] LADY JULIANA (Despondent): "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."
[00:31.00 - 00:33.00] ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
[00:31.00 - 00:35.80] PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate): "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
[00:35.80 - 00:39.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
[00:35.90 - 00:40.40] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative): "Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."
[00:40.50 - 00:42.80] ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.

ep046_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:03.50] ACTION: Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.
[00:07.80 - 00:11.00] SOUND FX: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.
[00:11.50 - 00:16.80] HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative): "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
[00:15.00 - 00:16.80] SOUND FX: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
[00:17.30 - 00:20.40] HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding): "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
[00:20.60 - 00:22.80] HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory): "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
[00:22.90 - 00:26.50] HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh): "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
[00:26.80 - 00:31.80] HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive): "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
[00:32.50 - 00:34.50] ACTION: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
[00:34.30 - 00:36.70] ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm): "She married the man... not the title."
[00:37.30 - 00:42.50] HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive): "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."

ep050_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.00] ACTION: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
[00:01.80 - 00:05.80] CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive): "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
[00:05.80 - 00:07.20] ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
[00:07.20 - 00:11.20] FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical): "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
[00:12.00 - 00:15.50] CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering): "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
[00:16.80 - 00:18.50] CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional): "Name your price."
[00:19.40 - 00:25.00] FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding): "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
[00:27.20 - 00:30.20] CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous): "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
[00:31.00 - 00:35.00] FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold): "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
[00:36.50 - 00:39.40] CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating): "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
[00:40.40 - 00:42.50] FATHER THOMAS (Grave): "For as long as it holds."

ep028_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.10] ACTION: Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.
[00:01.80 - 00:03.20] SOUND FX: Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.
[00:03.20 - 00:04.60] ACTION: Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.
[00:04.90 - 00:06.30] CATHERINE (Mocking, Cruel): "Look at her, Rupert."
[00:06.60 - 00:08.10] CATHERINE (Scoffing): "Soot on her face..."
[00:08.40 - 00:10.00] CATHERINE (Accusing, Smug): "...herbs in her pockets..."
[00:10.20 - 00:12.30] CATHERINE (Cold): "...a secret medicine in her hand."
[00:12.70 - 00:15.00] CATHERINE (Venomous): "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
[00:15.30 - 00:18.40] JULIANA (Furious, Defiant): "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
[00:18.90 - 00:20.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sardonic, Chilling): "A clever story, girl."
[00:20.40 - 00:22.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening): "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
[00:24.80 - 00:26.50] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining): "Rupert..."
[00:26.70 - 00:28.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding): "Stop this!"
[00:28.80 - 00:30.30] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm): "She is innocent."
[00:30.80 - 00:32.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant): "She saved me!"
[00:33.20 - 00:34.60] JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved): "Your Grace..."
[00:35.00 - 00:37.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
[00:38.20 - 00:40.00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning): "I was poisoned!"
[00:40.30 - 00:42.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing): "And you... you knew!"

ep039_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:04.60] ACTION: Men in work clothes stack wooden crates onto the back of a large carriage as horses snort restlessly in the morning mist.
[00:04.60 - 00:07.10] ACTION: The scout stands quietly by a wooden rail, keeping a sharp eye on passing civilians.
[00:13.80 - 00:15.80] ACTION: Four royal guards in red ceremonial tunics and tall black bearskin hats stand rigidly at attention with rifles on the grand cathedral staircase.
[00:18.30 - 00:19.90] LOYALIST SCOUT (Low, Urgent): "Six at the front."
[00:20.20 - 00:21.80] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Grave): "Four more inside."
[00:22.50 - 00:23.20] LOYALIST SCOUT (Focused): "And the east gate?"
[00:23.30 - 00:24.20] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Determined): "Ours."
[00:24.20 - 00:29.60] ACTION: A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.
[00:29.80 - 00:30.60] ROYAL SENTRY (Commanding): "Stop!"
[00:30.80 - 00:32.40] CART DRIVER (Meek, Deferential): "Firewood for the kitchens, sir."
[00:32.80 - 00:36.50] ACTION: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
[00:33.10 - 00:36.00] SOUND FX: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
[00:37.00 - 00:42.50] ACTION: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.
[00:41.00 - 00:42.20] LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold): "Sleep."

ep043_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.60 - 00:02.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Hysterical, Panicked): "You're lying!"
[00:02.40 - 00:03.90] ACTION: Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.
[00:03.90 - 00:07.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shrieking, Frantic): "This man is an imposter! Arrest him!"
[00:08.20 - 00:10.50] ACTION: Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.
[00:10.50 - 00:13.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enraged, Screaming): "I said arrest him!"
[00:13.80 - 00:16.00] ACTION: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.
[00:14.20 - 00:15.80] ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Defiant): "We will not."
[00:16.20 - 00:18.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Outraged, Stunned): "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"
[00:18.10 - 00:19.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate): "Your Duke!"
[00:19.20 - 00:21.60] ACTION: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.
[00:19.20 - 00:21.50] ROYAL GUARD (Calm, Resolute): "No. He is your Duke."
[00:22.00 - 00:24.00] ACTION: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
[00:24.10 - 00:25.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Flustered): "You have all been deceived!"
[00:26.10 - 00:28.00] ALEXANDER (Cold, Authoritative): "Then let the Crown decide."
[00:28.20 - 00:30.00] ACTION: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
[00:30.00 - 00:33.40] ALEXANDER (Grave, Powerful): "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."
[00:33.50 - 00:34.50] ALEXANDER (Commanding): "Read the first."
[00:35.20 - 00:37.00] ACTION: The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
[00:37.20 - 00:38.60] SOUND FX: Crisp sound of parchment turning.
[00:37.80 - 00:42.50] CROWN OFFICIAL (Clear, Formal): "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."

ep045_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.80] ACTION: Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.
[00:03.20 - 00:04.80] JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful): "Alexander..."
[00:05.20 - 00:07.80] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.
[00:07.40 - 00:08.90] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring): "Look at me."
[00:10.20 - 00:11.80] SOUND FX: Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
[00:12.50 - 00:14.30] JULIANA (Breathless, Overcome): "Your eyes..."
[00:15.20 - 00:18.50] ACTION: Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.
[00:17.10 - 00:18.70] JULIANA (Emotional, Realizing): "It's you."
[00:19.40 - 00:21.50] ALEXANDER (Solemn, Loving): "It was always me."
[00:21.90 - 00:24.20] ACTION: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
[00:22.90 - 00:24.40] JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering): "You're the Duke?"
[00:24.60 - 00:27.40] ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant): "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
[00:27.60 - 00:29.60] JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved): "All this time?"
[00:30.20 - 00:33.00] ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep): "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
[00:33.20 - 00:34.90] JULIANA (Sincere, Loving): "I chose you because you were kind."
[00:35.10 - 00:36.80] ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate): "You chose me when I had nothing."
[00:37.00 - 00:38.70] JULIANA (Resolute, Warm): "I chose you because you had honor."
[00:38.80 - 00:41.80] ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted): "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."

ep019_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:04.50] ACTION: Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.
[00:01.80 - 00:03.50] JULIANA (Sorrowful, Hollow): "This was our home."
[00:05.10 - 00:08.20] JULIANA (Emotional, Fragile): "My mother's book almost burned with it."
[00:06.50 - 00:09.20] ACTION: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
[00:12.10 - 00:15.20] ELDER VILLAGER (Respectful, Sincere): "My lady. You cannot stay here."
[00:16.10 - 00:19.00] ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.): "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
[00:18.50 - 00:20.50] ACTION: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.
[00:19.40 - 00:20.40] ELDER VILLAGER (Gentle, Earnest): "Take it."
[00:20.60 - 00:22.60] JULIANA (Hesitant, Humble): "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
[00:23.20 - 00:25.20] ELDER VILLAGER (Warm, Grateful): "You saved my son's life."
[00:26.40 - 00:27.80] ELDER VILLAGER (O.S.): "You saved mine, too."
[00:28.50 - 00:29.80] JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful): "Thank you."
[00:30.80 - 00:34.50] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
[00:31.20 - 00:33.20] ALEXANDER (Deep, Solemn): "We will not forget this kindness."
[00:33.30 - 00:34.80] ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest): "Neither will the village."
[00:35.50 - 00:37.40] JULIANA (Choked Up, Mournful): "Goodbye, Blackwood."
[00:38.00 - 00:41.50] ACTION: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.

ep042_opening_hook.text:
[00:01.00 - 00:10.50] ACTION: Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.
[00:11.20 - 00:12.60] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling): "Who are you?"
[00:12.80 - 00:14.60] ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant): "You already know."
[00:15.00 - 00:16.40] JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper): "Alexander..."
[00:16.80 - 00:17.90] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring): "Juliana."
[00:18.00 - 00:21.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[00:22.00 - 00:23.40] ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant): "We will not."
[00:23.50 - 00:25.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[00:25.50 - 00:26.50] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged): "Why?!"
[00:26.70 - 00:28.80] ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[00:29.00 - 00:30.30] CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[00:30.50 - 00:33.80] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[00:34.00 - 00:39.80] ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[00:40.20 - 00:42.50] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears): "Alexander..."

ep033_opening_hook.text:
[00:02.50 - 00:04.80] LORD (Cold, Authoritative): "Your brother is breathing again."
[00:04.00 - 00:06.50] ACTION: The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.
[00:06.50 - 00:08.50] MAID (Meek, Hesitant): "Yes, my Lord."
[00:09.50 - 00:11.80] LORD (Probing): "And who saved him?"
[00:13.00 - 00:14.50] MAID (Quiet, Truthful): "Lady Juliana."
[00:15.50 - 00:17.50] LORD (Measured, Demanding): "Tell me how."
[00:19.50 - 00:21.00] MAID (Faltering): "She... she used herbs."
[00:21.20 - 00:22.80] LORD (Sharp, Intimidating): "What herbs?"
[00:24.50 - 00:26.20] MAID (Whispering, Nervous): "I don't know."
[00:27.50 - 00:29.00] LORD (Stern): "You watched her."
[00:29.80 - 00:32.00] MAID (Tearful, Sincere): "I watched her save him."
[00:34.00 - 00:36.20] LORD (Coldly Dismissive): "That is not what I asked."
[00:37.50 - 00:40.00] LORD (Accusatory): "Did she use her mother's book?"
[00:42.20 - 00:43.60] MAID (Quietly Weeping): "Yes."

ep031_opening_hook.text:
[00:02.80 - 00:04.20] ACTION: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.
[00:06.90 - 00:08.80] CATHERINE (Cruel, Condescending): "Look at you."
[00:10.50 - 00:13.80] CATHERINE (Mocking, Venomous): "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[00:14.00 - 00:17.60] CATHERINE (Taunting): "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
[00:17.80 - 00:20.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Steady): "You seem very pleased."
[00:21.00 - 00:23.50] CATHERINE (Smug, Chilling): "I am."
[00:25.00 - 00:28.90] CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister): "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
[00:29.30 - 00:34.80] CATHERINE (Scornful): "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
[00:35.00 - 00:38.90] CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful): "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
[00:39.20 - 00:43.00] JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken): "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."

ep010_opening_hook.text:
[00:00.00 - 00:02.20] ACTION: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.
[00:02.10 - 00:03.30] SOUND FX: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
[00:02.20 - 00:03.50] ACTION: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
[00:05.10 - 00:06.60] JULIANA (Alarmed, Breathless): "Alexander!"
[00:07.50 - 00:09.00] ALEXANDER (Gruff, Strained): "It is nothing."
[00:09.15 - 00:11.45] JULIANA (Urgent, Worried): "There is blood running down your arm."
[00:11.90 - 00:14.30] ALEXANDER (Stiff, Dismissive): "A cut from the tenant fields."
[00:14.50 - 00:16.00] JULIANA (Commanding, Resolute): "Sit down."
[00:16.20 - 00:17.30] JULIANA (Stern): "Now."
[00:20.90 - 00:22.90] JULIANA (Gentle, Insistent): "I need to see the wound."
[00:23.20 - 00:24.90] ALEXANDER (Low, Defiant): "It is only a scratch."
[00:25.50 - 00:28.00] JULIANA (Sarcastic, Challenging): "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."
[00:38.10 - 00:38.90] JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed): "Dear God."

ep018_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:19.50 - 00:21.00] SOUND FX: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
[00:20.80 - 00:22.50] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Urgency): "Juliana! Get up!"
[00:24.50 - 00:28.90] ACTION: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.
[00:26.50 - 00:28.00] JULIANA (Breathless, Distressed): "What happened?"
[00:28.10 - 00:28.90] ALEXANDER (Grim, Urgent): "Fire."
[00:32.50 - 00:36.50] ACTION: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.
[00:33.20 - 00:35.20] ALEXANDER (Firm, Protective): "Stay close to me."
[00:38.00 - 00:41.50] ACTION: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.
[00:39.50 - 00:41.80] JULIANA (Panic-Stricken, Choked): "We cannot get through!"
[00:42.00 - 00:43.50] ALEXANDER (Resolute, Calm Under Pressure): "Then we go another way."
[00:45.00 - 00:48.50] SOUND FX: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
[00:56.20 - 00:58.50] ACTION: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
[00:56.50 - 00:57.80] JULIANA (Frantic, Desperate): "The ledger!"

ep035_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:37.00 - 00:40.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing, Stunned): "Alexander!"
[00:42.50 - 00:44.20] ALEXANDER (Breathless, In Disbelief): "Mother?"
[00:44.20 - 00:47.50] ACTION: She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.
[00:45.50 - 00:48.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping, Overwhelmed): "You're alive."
[00:48.00 - 00:49.80] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Choked Up): "Mother."
[00:50.00 - 00:55.50] ACTION: She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.
[00:52.50 - 00:55.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Heartbroken): "I buried you."
[00:56.50 - 00:58.00] ALEXANDER (Soft, Somber): "I know."
[00:59.50 - 01:06.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Anguished, Accusing): "They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."
[01:08.50 - 01:10.80] ALEXANDER (Dark, Resigned): "Most of them were."
[01:11.50 - 01:14.00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Searching, Desperate): "Then how did you survive?"

ep023_mid_confrontation.text:
[01:00.80 - 01:02.00] PRUDENCE (Urgent, Baffled): "What is it?"
[01:02.00 - 01:08.50] LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Deliberate): "Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."
[01:10.50 - 01:13.50] LADY JULIANA (Serious, Chilled): "I have seen these symptoms before."
[01:13.80 - 01:15.80] PRUDENCE (Panicked, Shaken): "What are you saying?"
[01:19.00 - 01:21.50] LADY JULIANA (Cold, Deadly Serious): "Someone is poisoning her."
[01:21.50 - 01:22.50] SOUND FX: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.
[01:22.00 - 01:24.00] PRUDENCE (Muffled, Horrified): "Poison?"
[01:26.00 - 01:28.00] LADY JULIANA (Venomous, Resolute): "Arsenic."
[01:28.00 - 01:30.50] SOUND FX: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
[01:34.50 - 01:37.00] PRUDENCE (Desperate, Begging): "Can you save her?"

ep026_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:56.00 - 01:02.00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Heartbroken): "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
[01:02.60 - 01:06.70] JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast): "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
[01:13.80 - 01:19.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching): "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
[01:20.00 - 01:25.80] JULIANA (Painful, Proud): "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
[01:27.00 - 01:30.50] ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[01:30.20 - 01:32.00] SOUND FX: A sharp, stunned gasp.

ep049_mid_confrontation.text:
[01:12.60 - 01:16.80] FATHER THOMAS (Direct): "What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once."
[01:17.20 - 01:23.80] CATHERINE (Calculating, Determined): "First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."
[01:24.20 - 01:31.20] CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising): "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."
[01:31.60 - 01:34.00] FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical): "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
[01:34.40 - 01:37.80] CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious): "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
[01:38.20 - 01:42.50] ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
[01:38.30 - 01:43.20] CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute): "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"

ep037_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:23.80 - 00:26.40] CATHERINE (Venomous Satisfaction): "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."
[00:26.60 - 00:29.80] CATHERINE (Gleeful): "Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."
[00:30.20 - 00:32.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Rupert) (Decisive): "Send the invitations."
[00:32.80 - 00:34.50] CATHERINE (Spiteful): "Especially to the Ashcrofts."
[00:37.00 - 00:39.80] BUTLER (Formal): "Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor."
[00:39.50 - 00:44.00] ACTION: Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
[00:44.50 - 00:46.50] LADY CLARISSA (Amused, Thrilled): "Catherine's wedding."
[00:47.00 - 00:49.20] NOBLEMAN (Observant): "So it is finally official."
[00:50.00 - 00:52.80] LADY CLARISSA (Mockingly Reverent): "Lady Catherine Ashbridge."

ep032_mid_confrontation.text:
[00:23.80 - 00:24.80] CATHERINE (Disconcerted): "What?"
[00:25.80 - 00:28.80] JULIANA (Firm, Resolute): "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
[00:29.80 - 00:32.80] JULIANA (Steely, Proud): "You may destroy the book..."
[00:33.20 - 00:36.20] JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant): "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
[00:36.40 - 00:39.10] CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing): "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
[00:39.20 - 00:42.80] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
[00:43.40 - 00:45.40] CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting): "You still think you are better?!"
[00:45.60 - 00:47.40] JULIANA (Serene, Grounded): "I know what I am."
[00:47.80 - 00:49.00] CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking): "A disgraced woman?"
[00:49.20 - 00:52.40] JULIANA (Unwavering): "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
